app.chaome.def: ChaoMe Theme Editor is an Android app that edits, builds and installs themes for Xiaomi phones with MIUI and HyperOS: icons, lock screen and fonts.
app.chaome.f1d: Icons, icon packs and masks, dynamic calendar and clock icons, wallpapers and lock screen, status bar, notifications, Control Center and volume panel, fonts, contacts, dialer and call screen.
app.chaome.f2d: Every screen shows your changes as you make them.
app.chaome.f3d: Checks a theme against the official theme rules (errors, warnings and store rules) and names the screen that fixes each one. Exports standard .mtz files for MIUI 9 to 14 and HyperOS 1 to 3.
app.chaome.f4d: On Android 11 and later, Shizuku puts the theme into Themes → My themes. Shizuku is optional: without it, the app still builds and exports .mtz files.
app.chaome.f5d: Open an installed theme to change it, start from a Light or Dark template, or build one from scratch.
app.chaome.f6d: Every theme you build is kept in a library on the phone: search it, compare two themes, reuse single parts, and back it up to a zip file.
app.chaome.h: A complete theme studio for Xiaomi phones: design, build and install MIUI and HyperOS themes on the phone itself.
app.cofferlock.def: Cofferlock is an Android app that locks photos, videos and files in one private vault on the phone, with no cloud and no account.
app.cofferlock.f1d: Your whole vault is one locked file. Keep it in any folder you like; to back it up, just copy that file.
app.cofferlock.f2d: Strong encryption locks every file: even someone who copies the vault file cannot read it without your password. If an import stops halfway, the vault is not damaged, and a built-in tool repairs a damaged vault.
app.cofferlock.f3d: Your password or your fingerprint. Forgot your password? 12 recovery words open your vault.
app.cofferlock.f4d: Folders, previews, search, filters and selecting many files at once. Open files in your usual apps, and no unlocked copy is left behind.
app.cofferlock.f5d: No account, no cloud, no tracking. It locks by itself, blocks screenshots and shows every unlock and every failed try. Free with a vault of up to 5 GB.
app.cofferlock.f6d: Unlimited space and more vaults, a decoy vault, encrypted Trash, one-tap backup, sealed envelopes and adding files from any app's Share menu. No subscription.
app.cofferlock.h: Keep your private photos, videos and documents locked in one vault that only you can open. It works like a normal file manager, and your files never leave your phone. No account and no cloud.
app.drofus.def: DROFUS is an Android app that writes bootable USB drives from Windows, Linux, macOS DMG, Raspberry Pi and DOS images, without a PC or root. DROFUS is an independent app, not affiliated with Rufus.
app.drofus.f1d: Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10 and 11, modern Linux distributions, macOS DMG (Intel), Raspberry Pi OS and ARM images, FreeDOS and MS-DOS.
app.drofus.f2d: GPT (UEFI) or MBR (BIOS), NTFS or FAT32, and automatic install.wim splitting for FAT32 — with official Microsoft ISOs, unmodified.
app.drofus.f3d: Bypass the Windows 11 minimum requirements and automate setup customization for Windows 10 and 11.
app.drofus.f4d: Keep your files and changes between boots on distributions that support it.
app.drofus.f5d: Flash drives, SD card adapters and external SSDs over OTG. Root only for the internal SD slot.
app.drofus.h: The full-power ISO burner for Android: PC-grade control over every bootable USB, with no PC at all.
app.mixdocs.def: MixDocs is an Android app that opens, edits, converts, scans and signs PDF and Office documents, with 59 tools and more than 50 file types.
app.mixdocs.f1d: PDF, Office and OpenDocument files in their original layout, plus Pages, Numbers, Keynote, e-books, comics, e-mail and images. Search, bookmarks, night mode and reflowed text make reading easy.
app.mixdocs.f2d: Highlight, draw, add notes and edit text and pictures in a PDF, and fill in forms. Write documents, work with formulas in spreadsheets, and present slides.
app.mixdocs.f3d: PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB or images, and many files to PDF at once. Merge, split, rotate and compress; recipes run several steps on many files.
app.mixdocs.f4d: Scan pages and ID cards, turn photos into text and searchable PDFs, and read QR codes and barcodes. Translate documents and listen to them read aloud, or save them as audio.
app.mixdocs.f5d: Sign by hand or with a digital signature, lock a PDF with a password, black out text so it is gone for good, and remove hidden data before you share.
app.mixdocs.f6d: Your documents never leave your phone: no account and no cloud. Every tool is free with ads; a one-time Pro purchase removes all ads and lets MixDocs work offline.
app.mixdocs.h: Open, edit, convert, scan and sign your documents in one app: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and more than 50 file types. Everything is processed on your phone, and every tool is free, with no page limits, no watermarks and no account.

app.tumtum.def: TumTum is an offline logic puzzle game for Android in which one swipe slides every character, with 1,100 levels.
app.tumtum.f1d: Every character slides until it hits something. Pits, spikes, crates, breakable blocks, one-way tiles, springs and belts keep it fresh.
app.tumtum.f2d: 110 chapters, and every level checked by hand for a clean, fair solution.
app.tumtum.f3d: No timers and no lives. Undo, restart or take a hint whenever you like.
app.tumtum.f4d: Hand-drawn characters that each move their own way, and soft music made for the game.
app.tumtum.f5d: Free, with no in-app purchases. Plays fully offline, in 11 languages.
app.tumtum.h: A cozy puzzle built on one brilliant rule — one swipe moves everyone — with 1,100 handmade levels to master.
app.ultimate-usb.def: Ultimate USB is an Android app that makes bootable USB drives, formats, partitions, tests, wipes and encrypts USB drives, recovers deleted files and manages PS2 and PS3 games, without a PC or root. It has 21 tools in 6 groups.
app.ultimate-usb.f1d: Write Windows 7–11, Linux, macOS (Intel) DMG, Raspberry Pi, FreeDOS and MS-DOS images, with Windows To Go and Linux persistence.
app.ultimate-usb.f2d: Install Ventoy, then keep many ISOs on one drive and choose at boot — with Secure Boot, MBR or GPT.
app.ultimate-usb.f3d: Format FAT16, FAT32, exFAT, NTFS and ext2/3/4, partition, convert MBR ↔ GPT, and back up or restore whole drives byte by byte.
app.ultimate-usb.f4d: Find failing sectors and fake-capacity drives, benchmark real speed, wipe securely, and protect drives with a password.
app.ultimate-usb.f5d: PS2 OPL utilities, PS3 ISO tools and a game converter for ISO, CSO, ZSO and CHD.
app.ultimate-usb.f6d: Its own C/C++ file-system drivers work over a plain OTG cable. Root is only needed for the internal SD slot.
app.ultimate-usb.h: Everything a PC does with a USB drive, done from your phone — the all-in-one USB workshop for Android.
app.usb-file-manager.def: USB File Manager is an Android app that opens USB drives formatted as NTFS, exFAT, FAT or ext4 and reads and writes their files, without a PC or root.
app.usb-file-manager.f1d: FAT, exFAT, NTFS and ext2/3/4, read and write, through the app's own native drivers.
app.usb-file-manager.f2d: Copy, move, rename and delete between the phone and the drive, and open or share files with any app.
app.usb-file-manager.f3d: Flash drives, card readers, hard disks and SSDs, hubs and drives with several partitions.
app.usb-file-manager.f4d: Open several drives and partitions at once in up to 12 tabs, side by side in two panes, with a queue you can pause, resume or stop.
app.usb-file-manager.f5d: Eject writes out every change before you unplug, and a warning flags drives that may store less than their size says. Root is only needed for the internal SD card slot.
app.usb-file-manager.h: Open any USB drive on Android — NTFS, exFAT, FAT and ext4 — and read and write it without root.
app.usb-tools.def: USB Tools is an Android app that formats, partitions, tests, wipes, backs up and recovers USB drives and manages PS2 and PS3 games on them, without a PC or root. It has 13 tools in 4 groups.
app.usb-tools.f1d: Try to bring corrupted and unreadable drives back, and format FAT16 to ext4 with MBR or GPT, cluster size and label.
app.usb-tools.f2d: The bad-blocks scan finds failing sectors and counterfeit capacity on flash drives and SD cards.
app.usb-tools.f3d: Sequential and random read/write benchmarks, plus device info and USB descriptors.
app.usb-tools.f4d: Erase all data and partitions, and get a signed PDF erasure certificate.
app.usb-tools.f5d: Full drive backup and restore, a FAT32/exFAT defragmenter (needed by PS2 OPL), and PS2/PS3 game tools.
app.usb-tools.h: A complete maintenance and rescue kit for USB drives: diagnose, repair, test and securely wipe — from your phone.
app.ventoy.def: Ventoy (Unofficial) is an Android app that installs Ventoy on a USB drive, so one drive holds many ISO files and boots any of them, without a PC or root. It is an independent app, not affiliated with the Ventoy project.
app.ventoy.f1d: Copy as many ISO files as the drive holds. No reformatting and no reburning, ever.
app.ventoy.f2d: Fetch ISO files directly onto the drive from inside the app.
app.ventoy.f3d: Windows 7–11 and all major Linux distributions, in UEFI or legacy BIOS, with Secure Boot support.
app.ventoy.f4d: GPT or MBR, exFAT, NTFS or FAT32, Windows 11 requirements bypass, and Ventoy themes and settings without editing files.
app.ventoy.h: Carry every operating system on one USB drive: install Ventoy from your phone, copy ISOs, and choose at boot.

fq.chaome.2: Why does my theme reset to the default after a while, and how do I keep it applied?
fq.chaome.3: The phone may go back to its default theme after a while, usually within a few hours. Xiaomi resets themes it did not sell. The app cannot make a theme stay permanently.
fq.chaome.4: Your edits stay in the .mtz file, so apply the theme again. A wallpaper set with Set Wallpaper stays even when the rest of the theme is reset.
fq.chaome.5: On recent HyperOS versions, Xiaomi's Themes app may refuse an edited theme. You can still try single parts under Customize theme in the Themes app.
fq.chaome.6: How do I install a theme from an .mtz file?
fq.chaome.7: To open a file, tap Browse on the start screen and pick the .mtz file, or open it from another app with Open with. A file that is cut off is reported as incomplete: download it again.
fq.chaome.8: After you export, the app offers to install the theme. On Android 10 and older it installs directly. From Android 11, installing needs the Shizuku app or root. On Android 13 and later, Shizuku started in ADB (wireless debugging) mode cannot install themes; Shizuku started with root can.
fq.chaome.9: Without installing, the .mtz file is still saved in your output folder. Apply it in the Themes app.
fq.chaome.10: Can I use a HyperOS theme on a MIUI phone?
fq.chaome.11: Yes, by converting it. In the Theme library, choose Convert for another system version (Pro). The result lists what changed and what is not shown on that system version. Nothing is removed, and the original theme is unchanged.
fq.chaome.12: What does the "theme rules not met" message mean when applying?
fq.chaome.13: ChaoMe's Theme check checks a theme against the official theme rules and lists each finding as Error, Warning or Store rule, with the screen that fixes it. For example, a theme without description.xml is not accepted by the Themes app. Theme check is advice only and never blocks an export.
fq.chaome.14: Open it from its tile in the editor, or from the button after a theme is saved. When it finds nothing, it shows No problems found.
fq.chaome.16: Why are my edits not in the exported theme file?
fq.chaome.17: In Settings, Status bar and Control Center set to System's own leaves the theme's status bar, notification and Control Center parts out of the export, together with your edits to them.
fq.chaome.18: Parts made for another system version may not show on your phone.
fq.chaome.19: Some editors exist only on certain system versions.
fq.chaome.20: After a Xiaomi reset the phone shows the default theme again, but the .mtz file keeps your edits.
fq.chaome.21: Can I keep some parts of the phone default (for example launcher art) while using a theme?
fq.chaome.22: Yes. Rows you leave alone keep the theme's own value. When you remove a piece of art, the phone's default shows instead. Reset Edits undoes the surfaces you pick. Hide Elements switches off parts of the system UI, and unchecking one restores it.
fq.chaome.23: In the Themes app, to change one part only, pick the plain entry under Customize theme.
fq.chaome.24: Can I change the icon shape for icon packs?
fq.chaome.25: Yes. After Import whole Icon Pack, set Shape of icon-pack icons: Circle, Squircle, Rounded square, Square or Teardrop. Original keeps the icons as they are. The shape applies only to apps that have no icon in the theme.
fq.chaome.26: Can I change the fingerprint icon on the lock screen?
fq.chaome.27: Yes. The Fingerprint tile has Fingerprint Icon and Unlock Animation. Pick a GIF or a picture and an effect, such as Pulse, Spin or Glow. The tile is shown on newer system versions.
fq.chaome.28: This works only with an in-screen sensor. Phones with the sensor on the side or the back do not draw a fingerprint icon on the lock screen.
fq.chaome.30: Does the app work on MIUI 14 and HyperOS?
fq.chaome.31: Yes. Themes can be built for MIUI 9.4 or earlier, MIUI 9.5 to 11, MIUI 12, 12.5, 13 and 14, and HyperOS 1, 2 and 3. Choose yours under Settings → Phone system version. The app runs on Android 7.0 and newer.
fq.chaome.33: Exported .mtz files go to MIUI/theme on your phone, or to a folder you choose on the export screen. Every theme you build is also kept in the Theme library inside the app. Uninstalling the app or clearing its data deletes the library, so back it up to a zip file from the library first.
fq.chaome.34: What does PRO add, and why does the free version need the internet?
fq.chaome.35: The free version is supported by ads and needs a connection while it is open. PRO is a one-time purchase that removes every ad, lets you use the app offline and opens the advanced tools: the advanced editors, lock screen options, the new lock screen builder, always-on display and power menu, MAML code, and combining and converting themes in the library. Every other editor stays free.
fq.chaome.38: No. Your themes are built on your phone and are never uploaded.
fq.chaome.39: Can I import a theme backup or a theme I bought?
fq.chaome.40: Your own theme backups (.bak) can be imported, and importing them is free. Bought or licensed themes are refused.
fq.chaome.43: No. ChaoMe Theme Editor is an independent tool for creating theme files. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Xiaomi.
fq.chaome.44: How long has ChaoMe been on Google Play, and how many people use it?
fq.chaome.45: Since June 2017. ChaoMe Theme Editor has more than 5,000,000 downloads on Google Play.
fq.chaome.desc: ChaoMe Theme Editor opens a theme or a downloaded .mtz file, lets you edit it and builds a new .mtz theme for MIUI and HyperOS phones. Editing and exporting work without Shizuku; installing on Android 11 and newer needs Shizuku or root.

fq.cofferlock.2: On first start, choose where the vault lives, choose a password and tap Create vault. Then write down the 12-word recovery phrase.
fq.cofferlock.3: The vault is one encrypted file that looks like random data. Put it anywhere you can reach, such as a folder, Downloads or an SD card. Copying that file is your backup, and it opens on any phone with your password.
fq.cofferlock.4: Where are my files stored, and how much can a vault hold?
fq.cofferlock.5: Your files are encrypted inside the vault file, at the place you chose, or in Cofferlock's own storage if you picked Keep it inside the app. A vault inside the app is deleted with the app's data and cannot be copied with a file manager.
fq.cofferlock.6: A free vault holds up to 5 GB. With Pro, the space is limited only by your phone storage. Any file type can go in.
fq.cofferlock.8: Use Import files, Import photos or Import a folder. A setting decides what happens to the originals: Ask (the default), Secure delete or Keep.
fq.cofferlock.9: How do I get a file out?
fq.cofferlock.10: Copy out saves the file outside the vault. The copy outside the vault is a normal, unencrypted file. You can also select a folder or several files and copy them out.
fq.cofferlock.11: Open shows the file in another app without saving an unencrypted copy.
fq.cofferlock.12: I forgot my password. What can I do?
fq.cofferlock.13: On the unlock screen, tap Forgot password? Use recovery phrase, type your 12 words and choose a new password.
fq.cofferlock.14: Without the phrase, nobody can open the vault, including us. There is no backdoor.
fq.cofferlock.15: How do I back up my vault or move it to a new phone?
fq.cofferlock.16: Copy the vault file with any file manager. A vault kept inside the app is copied with Settings → Copy file (free). With Pro, Back up copies it to a folder you choose and reminds you while the phone charges if the last backup is over a week old. Android cloud backup is off for vault data.
fq.cofferlock.17: On the new phone, install Cofferlock, choose I already have a vault file and enter your password. Vault file names start with a dot, so choose Show hidden files in the file picker's menu.
fq.cofferlock.18: Can I unlock with my fingerprint?
fq.cofferlock.19: Yes, per vault, on Android 9 and newer. You can always unlock with your password too. If you add or remove fingerprints in Android, unlock with the password and turn Fingerprint unlock on again in Settings.
fq.cofferlock.21: No for your vaults: creating, opening and using vaults never needs the internet. The app uses it only to check for a newer version and to confirm a Pro purchase with Google Play. Your files and personal details are never sent.
fq.cofferlock.23: You must wait longer and longer: after 5 wrong tries 1 minute, after 10 tries 1 hour. This can be switched off. The Security tab shows every unlock and every failed try.
fq.cofferlock.24: With Pro you can also choose to erase the vault after 10 or 20 wrong passwords in a row.
fq.cofferlock.25: Can I have more than one vault?
fq.cofferlock.26: Yes, with Pro. Several vaults and a decoy vault are part of Pro. Opening any vault file is free.
fq.cofferlock.27: What does Pro add, and is there a subscription?
fq.cofferlock.28: No subscription: Pro is a one-time purchase. It adds unlimited space and more than one vault, a decoy vault, an emergency erase password, a disguised app name and icon, sealed envelopes, an encrypted Trash, faster ways to add files, one-tap backup with reminders and the full security history, and more.
fq.cofferlock.29: The Supporter edition has the same features. Restore purchase turns Pro back on for the Google account that bought it.
fq.cofferlock.30: Can someone read my vault if they copy the vault file?
fq.cofferlock.31: No. Strong encryption locks every file, so a copied vault file cannot be read without your password.
fq.cofferlock.32: What happens if the app closes during an import?
fq.cofferlock.33: Your vault is not damaged. If an import stops halfway or the app is closed, the vault stays safe, and a built-in repair tool can fix a damaged vault.
fq.cofferlock.34: Can other people see my vault in screenshots or recent apps?
fq.cofferlock.35: No. Screenshots are blocked, the app is hidden in recent apps, and copied text is cleared. The vault locks by itself 30 seconds after you leave the app, or when you tap Lock.
fq.cofferlock.36: Does Cofferlock show ads or track me?
fq.cofferlock.37: No. Cofferlock has no ads, no tracking, no account and no cloud.
fq.cofferlock.desc: Cofferlock keeps your photos, videos and files in one encrypted vault file on your phone. Your files never leave the phone, there is no account, and the free version holds up to 5 GB. Pro adds unlimited space and more vaults.

fq.drofus.2: How many tokens does a write or a format use, and how do I earn one?
fq.drofus.3: The app shows the number of tokens before you confirm:
fq.drofus.4: A Windows installation or Windows To Go: 2 tokens.
fq.drofus.5: A Linux ISO with Advanced Options (Filesystem, Partition & Persistence) ticked: 2 tokens.
fq.drofus.6: MS-DOS, FreeDOS and Non-bootable (format only): 1 token.
fq.drofus.7: An image written as it is (Linux, Raspberry Pi, DMG and other .img files): free.
fq.drofus.8: To earn a token, tap the token counter on the main screen to open Get Tokens, then tap Watch under Get 1 free token. One short rewarded video (60 seconds at most) gives 1 token. Free tokens stop at a balance of 5, and at 4 videos each time you open the app. You can also buy a pack. With Pro, no write uses tokens. More: DROFUS tokens.
fq.drofus.9: What happens to my tokens when a write does not complete?
fq.drofus.10: They come back automatically. Tokens are taken when you tap OK, before the burn starts. If the burn fails or you cancel it, or you answer No to the question about overwriting the whole drive, the app gives them back.
fq.drofus.11: If the app is closed during a burn, the tokens come back the next time you open the app.
fq.drofus.12: Why does the rewarded ad not load, and what can I do to still earn a token?
fq.drofus.13: This is nearly always the network. Try these in order:
fq.drofus.14: Private DNS: open Settings, search for Private DNS, choose Private DNS provider hostname and enter dns.google. Save, switch the connection off and on, then restart the app.
fq.drofus.15: Turn off ad blockers and blocking VPNs for the app.
fq.drofus.16: Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data.
fq.drofus.17: Watch the ad to the end and close it with the X. Pressing Back early cancels the reward.
fq.drofus.18: If the ad finished and the balance did not change, force-stop the app (Settings → Apps → the app → Force stop) and open it again while online. You can also buy tokens, or get Pro, which turns the token system off.
fq.drofus.19: Why does the app say an ad blocker or private DNS is active?
fq.drofus.20: The free version cannot load its ads through an ad blocker, a blocking VPN or ad-blocking Private DNS. Running operations wait until it is switched off for the app. Set Private DNS to dns.google or turn it off, then restart the app.
fq.drofus.21: Pro, or any token pack you bought on this install, lets the app run with an ad blocker on.
fq.drofus.22: Why does the app need an internet connection?
fq.drofus.23: Burning does not need it. The free version needs a connection for its banner and rewarded video ads, which keep the core features free. While you are offline it shows No Internet Connection and running operations wait. They continue on their own when you are back online.
fq.drofus.25: Can I pay instead of watching ads, and what does a purchase include?
fq.drofus.26: Yes. You can buy tokens, or buy Pro. Pro is a one-time, lifetime purchase with no subscription. It removes all ads, turns the token system off, and lets you use the app offline or with an ad blocker on. The burning features are the same with and without Pro.
fq.drofus.28: Why is my USB drive not detected (USB-C drive, card reader, OTG adapter)?
fq.drofus.29: The phone has to detect the drive first. Work through this list:
fq.drofus.30: Open the phone's Settings, search for OTG and switch it on if the option exists. The app has a built-in guide for this.
fq.drofus.31: Use a data OTG adapter. Charge-only cables cannot carry data.
fq.drofus.32: When Android asks whether the app may use the USB device, tap OK. If you refused, unplug the drive and plug it in again. Check that the mode on the main screen is USB OTG, not SD Slot.
fq.drofus.33: Plug in a FAT32 or exFAT drive and check that the phone notices it. If even that drive is not noticed, the cause is the cable, the port or the drive.
fq.drofus.34: Test the drive on a PC, and check the phone's port for dust.
fq.drofus.35: DROFUS works with USB flash drives, SD card adapters and external SSDs.
fq.drofus.37: No, not for USB drives over OTG. Root is needed only for the phone's internal SD card slot. Without root, put the card in a USB card reader and connect it over OTG.
fq.drofus.38: Why does Android say my NTFS drive is damaged or unsupported?
fq.drofus.39: After a drive is written as NTFS, or after a bootable drive is written, Android may say the drive is damaged or unsupported. That is expected: many phones cannot read NTFS on their own. The write succeeded.
fq.drofus.40: Dismiss the notice and do not tap Android's offer to format: it would erase the drive. To read and write NTFS drives on the phone, you can use our USB File Manager app.
fq.drofus.41: What does "CRITICAL WARNING: BAD DRIVE!" mean?
fq.drofus.42: DROFUS checks the drive when you connect it. If reading or writing at the end of the drive fails, the drive may be faulty or counterfeit (smaller than it claims), or the cable may be loose. The app then asks whether to Scan for real size or Continue anyway. 🛑 CRITICAL WARNING: BAD DRIVE! appears if the drive drops out or stops answering during this check: try another cable or drive. It is also the title of the scan's results.
fq.drofus.43: The scan finds the size the drive really stores; tap Yes to use it, and every burn stays inside it. If you keep the claimed size, the burn warns you once, with Continue and Cancel, before anything is written and before any token is used.
fq.drofus.45: How do I make a Windows 10 or Windows 11 installer, and can I choose the edition?
fq.drofus.46: The burn screen opens when you start the app:
fq.drofus.47: Keep Boot Selection on Disk or ISO image.
fq.drofus.48: Tap Pick ISO and choose the Windows ISO. The app reads the file.
fq.drofus.49: If the app shows the Windows type, keep Standard Windows Installation. Choose the Partition Table and File System, and set the Windows Setup Customization options you want.
fq.drofus.50: Tap START. The app shows All Data Will Be Permanently Deleted and the tokens it uses. Tap OK.
fq.drofus.51: Official Microsoft ISOs work unmodified. With Windows To Go, an image with more than one edition shows a list of editions; the app selects a Pro edition first and you can choose another. Keep the app in front until the burn finishes.
fq.drofus.52: Which Windows versions can I write?
fq.drofus.53: Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10 and 11. The Windows Setup Customization options are for Windows 10 and 11 images.
fq.drofus.54: How do I install Windows 11 on a PC without TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot?
fq.drofus.55: Keep Remove requirement for 4GB+ RAM, Secure Boot and TPM 2.0. ticked in the Windows Setup Customization card. It is shown for Windows 11 images and is on by default for a standard installation. The card is not shown when the image has its own unattend file.
fq.drofus.56: The same card can remove the online Microsoft account requirement, create a local account, skip the privacy questions, copy the regional options from your phone and turn off automatic BitLocker encryption. Nothing you enter leaves the phone.
fq.drofus.57: My Windows ISO has a file over 4 GB. Can I still use FAT32?
fq.drofus.58: Yes. That file is install.wim. Tick Split image for FAT32 compatibility. in the Advanced File System card. The app splits the file into parts so the drive can stay FAT32, and Windows setup puts the parts back together. Splitting takes a long time.
fq.drofus.59: The option is shown when the image can be split, the drive is 2 TB or smaller and Windows To Go is not chosen. Without it, the app uses NTFS, which has no size limit but is not accepted by every UEFI firmware.
fq.drofus.60: Where is the Windows To Go option?
fq.drofus.61: Pick a Windows ISO that supports Windows To Go. The app then shows the choice between Standard Windows Installation and Windows To Go. The choice is not shown for other images or for a bare .wim file.
fq.drofus.62: Windows To Go puts a portable Windows 10 or 11 on the USB drive, which then boots and runs from the drive. It uses NTFS and can take several hours: use a fast phone and a fast USB drive, turn on High-speed mode, and start with a fully charged phone.
fq.drofus.64: Which Linux images work, and when should I use GPT/UEFI or MBR?
fq.drofus.65: Modern GNU/Linux distributions released after 2010 work, for example Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian and Arch. By default the image is written as it is, which uses no tokens.
fq.drofus.66: Tick Advanced Options (Filesystem, Partition & Persistence) to copy the files instead and choose the file system, the Partition Table and a persistent partition (2 tokens). Choose GPT (UEFI) for PCs that start in UEFI mode and MBR (BIOS or UEFI-CSM) for legacy BIOS or CSM mode. The app preselects the table the image supports.
fq.drofus.67: Persistence keeps your files and changes between boots. It is offered only for images that support it, and the app says why when it is not.
fq.drofus.68: Can I burn a macOS DMG or a Raspberry Pi image?
fq.drofus.69: Yes, with Disk or ISO image and no token cost. macOS DMG (Intel-based only), Raspberry Pi OS and other ARM images are written as they are. You can pick compressed .gz, .xz, .bz2 and .zip images without unpacking them first.
fq.drofus.71: How long does a write take, and why can it be slow?
fq.drofus.72: The speed depends on the USB drive and on the phone's USB port. A USB 3.0 drive in a USB 2.0 adapter runs at USB 2.0 speed, and many small files write much slower than one large file. Large images take time.
fq.drofus.73: High-speed mode. (Recommended) is on when the phone has enough free storage for it. Windows To Go can take several hours.
fq.drofus.74: Why did the write stop at a percentage or the app close during the write?
fq.drofus.75: The app was minimised. A burn pauses while the app is in the background and continues when it is in front again.
fq.drofus.76: No internet or an ad blocker (free version). Running burns wait until this is fixed. Pro does not pause for these.
fq.drofus.77: The drive was removed or stopped answering. During a burn, the app shows Device Removed with Retry. Plug the same drive back in and tap Retry: most burns continue where they stopped (a Windows To Go burn in normal mode repeats its image step). A different drive is never written. If you cancel instead, the tokens come back.
fq.drofus.78: A stop near the very end often means the drive reports more space than it has, or its flash fails at the end. Reconnect the drive: if the end of the drive fails the check, the app asks whether to Scan for real size or Continue anyway.
fq.drofus.79: If the app was closed during a burn, the tokens come back the next time you open it.
fq.drofus.80: Can I use other apps while a write is running?
fq.drofus.81: No. A burn pauses when the app leaves the foreground, to protect the drive. Keep the app open and in front until it finishes. The app keeps the screen on while it is shown. Start long burns when you do not need the phone.
fq.drofus.82: My PC does not boot from the USB drive. What should I check?
fq.drofus.83: Boot menu: select the USB drive in the PC's boot menu (often F12, F11, F9 or Esc at power-on).
fq.drofus.84: Secure Boot: turn it off in the BIOS/UEFI, or use an image that supports it.
fq.drofus.85: Partition scheme: GPT drives need UEFI mode; MBR drives need legacy or CSM mode.
fq.drofus.86: USB port: try a port directly on the motherboard, not on the front panel or a hub.
fq.drofus.87: The ISO: download it again from the official source. A truncated ISO writes without error but does not boot. DROFUS warns when an ISO looks truncated.
fq.drofus.88: My drive shows less space after writing. How do I get the full capacity back?
fq.drofus.89: A bootable write can leave hidden partitions. Write the drive again with Boot Selection set to Non-bootable: it formats the drive with FAT32, exFAT or NTFS (1 token).
fq.drofus.90: Drive makers count in decimal gigabytes and phones in binary ones, so a "64 GB" drive holds about 59 GiB. A large shortfall can mean a counterfeit drive.
fq.drofus.91: Can the app damage my USB drive?
fq.drofus.92: No. Nothing the app does is unrecoverable at the hardware level; the worst case is a drive that needs formatting again. If a drive stopped working after an operation, it was already failing.
fq.drofus.93: Before a burn, the app warns when an ISO looks truncated or corrupted, warns when the file is not bootable, checks the space on the drive and in phone storage, and asks for confirmation before it erases the drive.
fq.drofus.94: Is the app safe, and is my data uploaded anywhere?
fq.drofus.95: Your files are processed on your phone, and their contents are never uploaded. There is no account and no sign-up. The Windows setup options you enter do not leave the phone. What the app does send, such as ad requests, crash reports and purchase checks, is listed in its privacy policy.
fq.drofus.97: How is DROFUS related to Rufus?
fq.drofus.98: DROFUS is an independent app, not affiliated with Rufus. It is an ISO burner for Android that writes the drive from your phone, with no PC.
fq.drofus.100: It has been retired. Every feature it had is in DROFUS, which is also known as ISO 2 USB or ISO to USB.
fq.drofus.101: If a purchase cannot be checked, the app shows Could not verify the purchase. Try again later.
fq.drofus.102: If a card reader has no card in it, the app says that there is no card or disk in the drive.
fq.drofus.103: Sometimes the drive fails this check. The app then says so and offers Try restore again. A burn still runs after one more Yes; No gives the tokens back.
fq.drofus.104: A short connection failure. It does not stop the job: the app tries again and goes on.
fq.drofus.105: A drive that is write-protected, or one that does not take writes, is refused at the start with one message, before any question and before any token is used.
fq.drofus.106: The app asks for Bluetooth permission only on Android 8.1 and older.
fq.drofus.107: Which languages is the app available in?
fq.drofus.108: 58 languages. The most recently added are Azerbaijani, Catalan, Estonian, Kazakh, Lithuanian, Latvian, Malayalam, Slovak, Slovenian, Swahili, Tagalog (Filipino) and Uzbek.
fq.drofus.109: On Android 13 and later, you can choose the app's language in the phone's settings.
fq.drofus.110: For Windows 11, QoL improvements stops Windows from forcing Copilot, OneDrive, Outlook, Fast Startup and more. Recent Windows 11 images also offer "Windows CA 2023" bootloaders for a compatible PC, and Apply SkuSiPolicy.p7b on installation (See KB5042562). With Windows To Go, Set the target's internal drives offline is on by default.
fq.drofus.111: Before the drive is wiped, the app shows Checking image…: an incomplete or unreadable image is refused, and nothing is written to the drive. When a burn formats the drive, the app checks and tests the file system before it reports success. Every format is tested before success is shown, image writes wait until the drive confirms the data is written, and a job only ever writes to the drive it started on.
fq.drofus.112: Why did the burn fail, and what does the message mean?
fq.drofus.113: The message names the cause, and you do not lose the tokens:
fq.drofus.115: The image is incomplete or damaged: download it again.
fq.drofus.116: The Windows image (WIM) cannot be split for FAT32: choose NTFS.
fq.drofus.117: The drive did not keep the copy: it may be counterfeit.
fq.drofus.118: NTFS could not start: choose FAT32 or exFAT.
fq.drofus.119: The phone does not have enough memory.
fq.drofus.120: If the BIOS boot loader cannot be installed for a Linux image that is copied file by file, the burn does not fail: the drive is finished with the note It may start only on UEFI computers.
fq.drofus.121: How long has DROFUS been on Google Play, and how many people use it?
fq.drofus.122: Since July 2022. DROFUS has more than 1,000,000 downloads on Google Play, and we have built USB apps for more than five years.
fq.drofus.desc: DROFUS writes bootable Windows, Linux, DMG and Raspberry Pi drives from your phone over USB OTG, without root. Raw writes are free; Windows and Linux file-copy writes use 2 tokens, MS-DOS, FreeDOS and Non-bootable use 1, and Pro uses none.

fq.mixdocs.2: MixDocs has the tabs Files, Scan and Tools. Files shows your recent documents: tap one to open it, or long-press to select several. Add a folder to show its files.
fq.mixdocs.3: To create a new file, tap + in Files and choose a Word document, a sheet, slides, a blank PDF or a template.
fq.mixdocs.5: PDF (also password-protected files and forms), Word (DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF), Excel (XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, TSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT, ODP), Pages, Numbers, Keynote, Publisher, Visio, Hangul (HWP, HWPX), e-books and comics (EPUB, MOBI, AZW, AZW3 without DRM, FB2, CHM, CBZ, CBR), e-mail (EML, MSG), XPS, text, Markdown, HTML, source code and images: more than 50 file types. Office files open in their original layout.
fq.mixdocs.7: Open the Scan tab and start a scan. The edges are found for you. Choose full, basic or ID card mode, then rotate, crop, recolour, reorder or delete pages before you save. Scans are saved as a PDF in Download/MixDocs.
fq.mixdocs.9: New files go to Download/MixDocs. Use Save as… on any result to choose another place, or change the folder in Settings → Where new files go. After a reinstall, choose Download/MixDocs there to list your older files again.
fq.mixdocs.10: Does a tool change my original file?
fq.mixdocs.11: No. Your original stays as it is, and the result is saved as a new file. The original changes only if you choose Replace original.
fq.mixdocs.12: Can I edit PDFs and Office files?
fq.mixdocs.13: Yes. In a PDF, long-press words to edit the text, and add or change pictures and objects from More. The mark-up tools highlight, underline, draw, and add notes and text. You can fill forms and sign by hand or by typing.
fq.mixdocs.14: Word, OpenDocument and RTF documents, spreadsheets and presentations can be edited too.
fq.mixdocs.16: Files open and can be read offline and with an ad blocker. Tools, converters and Scan are free thanks to ads, so in the free version they need the internet with ads allowed. With Pro, every tool works offline with no ads. Buying Pro needs a connection once.
fq.mixdocs.17: A translation, handwriting or spell-check language, and the background-removal tool, need a connection once, when they are downloaded.
fq.mixdocs.18: Why does it ask me to turn off an ad blocker?
fq.mixdocs.19: An ad blocker is stopping the few ads that keep the tools free. Turn off the ad-blocking app, VPN or Private DNS (Android Settings → Network & internet → Private DNS → Automatic or Off), then tap I've allowed ads — check again. Pro removes ads and this check.
fq.mixdocs.21: No. Your documents are opened and changed on your phone; they are never uploaded. There is no account and no cloud. Private mode keeps no recent list, reading positions or search index, and blocks screenshots.
fq.mixdocs.22: Does text recognition or translation need the internet?
fq.mixdocs.23: Partly. Text recognition runs on the phone with more than 20 scripts built in. Translation downloads a language once on first use. The dictionary downloads once and then works offline.
fq.mixdocs.24: What does Pro give, and how do I restore it?
fq.mixdocs.25: Pro is a one-time purchase that removes all ads and lets MixDocs work offline and with an ad blocker. Every tool and feature is free for everyone, with no limits and no watermarks; Pro does not unlock tools.
fq.mixdocs.26: Pro is tied to your Google Play account. You can also use Settings → MixDocs Pro → Restore. If a payment is pending, Pro turns on by itself once it goes through.
fq.mixdocs.28: Yes. Every tool and feature is free, with no page limits, no watermarks and no account.
fq.mixdocs.29: The free version shows ads: banners and cards on its screens, a banner under the document you read, and full-screen ads at breaks, such as after a tool finishes. Ads never cover a document's pages and never appear in an editor or a dialog.
fq.mixdocs.30: Can I protect a PDF with a password or remove text for good?
fq.mixdocs.31: Yes. You can add passwords to PDF and Office files. Redaction removes the text for good and checks the result, and you can remove hidden data from a file. You can also add or check digital signatures in a PDF.
fq.mixdocs.desc: MixDocs opens, edits, converts, scans and signs PDF and Office files on your phone. Every tool is free, with no page limits and no watermarks; documents are never uploaded. Pro removes ads and lets MixDocs work offline and with an ad blocker.

fq.tumtum.2: Swipe on the board. One swipe moves every character at the same time, and each one slides until it hits a wall, another character or its own door. Get them all home.
fq.tumtum.3: The first levels teach the rule. Later boards add pits, spikes, sliding crates, breaking blocks, one-way tiles, springs and moving belts.
fq.tumtum.4: Is there a time limit or lives?
fq.tumtum.5: No timer and no lives. Each level has a move limit: when you run out, the game shows Out of moves. The limit is based on the shortest solution, and the game tells you how many moves it takes and how many you have.
fq.tumtum.6: What happens when a character falls?
fq.tumtum.7: Pits and spikes are one-way: only Undo brings a character back. When one falls, the game shows One fell!. Tap Undo a move or Start over.
fq.tumtum.8: A level seems impossible. What can I do?
fq.tumtum.9: Every level has a solution. The order of your swipes matters. Use Undo or Restart as often as you like, or tap Hint.
fq.tumtum.10: How do hints and coins work?
fq.tumtum.11: A hint costs 10 coins, and a new game starts with 10 coins. You earn coins by solving levels for the first time (more for more stars), from a bonus for 3-star streaks, and from a Chapter chest every fifth chapter. Replays pay nothing.
fq.tumtum.12: If you tap Hint without enough coins and a video is ready, you can tap Watch an ad to earn 15 coins. Watching is always optional.
fq.tumtum.14: Each level gives 1 to 3 stars, based on how many moves you used compared with the shortest solution.
fq.tumtum.16: Learn explains each element on the current board, page by page. It is there in chapters 1 to 28, where the elements are introduced.
fq.tumtum.17: Is TumTum free? Are there in-app purchases?
fq.tumtum.18: TumTum is free and supported by ads. It has no in-app purchases and no Pro version. Every level unlocks by playing. There is no account and no sign-up.
fq.tumtum.20: Yes. Every level plays fully offline. Ads and the optional videos for extra coins need a connection.
fq.tumtum.21: Is my progress kept on a new phone?
fq.tumtum.22: Progress, stars and coins are saved on your device. There is no account and no cloud save, so clearing the game's data or uninstalling it resets your progress.
fq.tumtum.23: If Android backup is on, reinstalling on the same phone model may bring the progress back. On a different phone model the game starts fresh. Ad consent is asked again after a restore.
fq.tumtum.24: Can I turn off music or sounds, or change the language?
fq.tumtum.25: Open Settings → Sound & vibration. Sound, music and vibration each have a switch, and sound and music have a volume slider.
fq.tumtum.26: TumTum is available in 11 languages and follows your phone's language. To choose another, open Settings → Language; pick System default to follow the phone again. The game works in portrait and landscape.
fq.tumtum.desc: TumTum is a free sliding puzzle game with 1100 levels. One swipe moves every character at once. It plays offline, has no timers and no lives, and has no in-app purchases; ads pay for it.

fq.ultimate-usb.2: How many tokens does a write or a format use, and how do I earn one?
fq.ultimate-usb.3: The app shows the number of tokens before you confirm. These actions use tokens:
fq.ultimate-usb.4: Ventoy: Install 2, Update 1, Clear 1. Copying or downloading files, Theme Manager, Config Hub and persistence are free.
fq.ultimate-usb.5: ISO Burner: 2 when the image's files are copied (for example a Windows ISO), none when the image is written as it is, and 1 for MS-DOS, FreeDOS or Non-bootable.
fq.ultimate-usb.6: Format USB: 1. Partition Wizard: 1 for each Create or Format step, at most 3 per Apply Changes.
fq.ultimate-usb.7: PS2 USB Utils: 1 when Fix has to format the drive. USB Encryption: 1 for Encrypt Drive.
fq.ultimate-usb.8: Raw Write, Wipe USB, the recovery tools, Bad Blocks Check, Benchmark, Backup / Restore, USB Defragmenter, the file tools and the game tools use no tokens.
fq.ultimate-usb.9: To earn a token, tap the token counter on the main screen to open Get Tokens, then tap Watch under Get 1 free token. One short rewarded video (60 seconds at most) gives 1 token. Free tokens stop at a balance of 5, and at 4 videos each time you open the app. You can also buy a pack. With Pro, no action uses tokens. More: Ultimate USB tokens.
fq.ultimate-usb.10: What happens to my tokens when a write does not complete?
fq.ultimate-usb.11: They come back automatically. Tokens are taken when you tap OK, before the job starts. If the job fails or is cancelled, or you answer No to the question about overwriting the whole drive, the app gives them back.
fq.ultimate-usb.12: If the app is closed during a job, the tokens come back the next time you open the app.
fq.ultimate-usb.13: When a Partition Wizard run stops partway, the tokens for the Create and Format steps that finished are kept, and the rest come back.
fq.ultimate-usb.14: Why does the rewarded ad not load, and what can I do to still earn a token?
fq.ultimate-usb.15: This is nearly always the network. Try these in order:
fq.ultimate-usb.16: Private DNS: open Settings, search for Private DNS, choose Private DNS provider hostname and enter dns.google. Save, switch the connection off and on, then restart the app.
fq.ultimate-usb.17: Turn off ad blockers and blocking VPNs for the app.
fq.ultimate-usb.18: Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data.
fq.ultimate-usb.19: Watch the ad to the end and close it with the X. Pressing Back early cancels the reward.
fq.ultimate-usb.20: If the ad finished and the balance did not change, force-stop the app (Settings → Apps → the app → Force stop) and open it again while online. You can also buy a token pack, or get Pro, which uses no tokens.
fq.ultimate-usb.21: Why does the app say an ad blocker or private DNS is active?
fq.ultimate-usb.22: The free version cannot load its ads through an ad blocker, a blocking VPN or ad-blocking Private DNS. Running operations wait until it is switched off for the app. Set Private DNS to dns.google or turn it off, then restart the app.
fq.ultimate-usb.23: Pro, or any token pack you bought on this install, lets the app run with an ad blocker on.
fq.ultimate-usb.24: Why does the app need an internet connection?
fq.ultimate-usb.25: The tools themselves do not need it. The free version needs a connection to load ads, which pay for the free tools. While you are offline it shows No Internet Connection and running operations wait. They continue on their own when you are back online.
fq.ultimate-usb.27: Can I pay instead of watching ads, and what does a purchase include?
fq.ultimate-usb.28: Yes. You can buy a token pack, or buy Pro. Pro is a one-time, lifetime purchase with no subscription: no ads, no tokens, and full offline use, also with an ad blocker on. The tools are the same with and without Pro.
fq.ultimate-usb.29: Pro is tied to your Google account. Tokens are stored on your device.
fq.ultimate-usb.31: Why is my USB drive not detected (USB-C drive, card reader, OTG adapter)?
fq.ultimate-usb.32: The phone has to detect the drive first. Work through this list:
fq.ultimate-usb.33: Open the phone's Settings, search for OTG and switch it on if the option exists.
fq.ultimate-usb.34: Use a data OTG adapter. Charge-only cables cannot carry data.
fq.ultimate-usb.35: When Android asks whether the app may use the USB device, tap OK. If you refused, unplug the drive and plug it in again. Check that the mode on the main screen is USB OTG, not SD Slot.
fq.ultimate-usb.36: Plug in a FAT32 or exFAT drive and check that the phone notices it. If even that drive is not noticed, the cause is the cable, the port or the drive.
fq.ultimate-usb.37: Test the drive on a PC, and check the phone's port for dust.
fq.ultimate-usb.38: Flash drives, portable SSDs, card readers and OTG hubs work. Hard disk drives (HDDs) are not officially supported because of power limits. If you try one, charge the phone and use a powered USB hub.
fq.ultimate-usb.40: No, not for USB drives over OTG. The app reads and writes FAT16, FAT32, exFAT, NTFS and EXT2/3/4 drives.
fq.ultimate-usb.41: Root is needed only for the phone's internal SD card slot. Without root, put the card in a USB card reader and connect it over OTG.
fq.ultimate-usb.42: Can I use an NTFS drive on Android?
fq.ultimate-usb.43: Yes. Ultimate USB opens NTFS drives in its own USB File Manager, also when the phone itself cannot read them.
fq.ultimate-usb.44: After you format or write a drive as NTFS, Android may say the drive is damaged or unsupported. That is expected: many phones cannot read NTFS on their own. Dismiss the notice and do not tap Android's offer to format: it would erase the drive.
fq.ultimate-usb.45: For a drive that the phone's own apps can read, use exFAT. Partition Mounter can also make a partition available to other apps through the Android Files app.
fq.ultimate-usb.46: What does "CRITICAL WARNING: BAD DRIVE!" mean, and how do I find a fake-capacity drive?
fq.ultimate-usb.47: The app checks the drive when you connect it. If reading or writing at the end of the drive fails, the drive may be fake or faulty, and the app asks whether to Scan for real size or Continue anyway. The scan finds the size the drive really stores; tap Yes to use it, and every tool then works inside it. 🛑 CRITICAL WARNING: BAD DRIVE! appears if the drive drops out or stops answering during this check: try another cable or drive. It is also the title of the scan's results.
fq.ultimate-usb.48: No tool refuses such a drive. If you keep the claimed size, every write warns you once, with Continue and Cancel, before anything is written and before any token is used.
fq.ultimate-usb.49: For a full test, run Bad Blocks Check with Detect fake / counterfeit capacity ticked. It tests the whole drive and erases everything on it.
fq.ultimate-usb.51: How do I make a bootable Windows USB from my phone?
fq.ultimate-usb.53: Open ISO Burner and keep Boot Selection on Disk or ISO image.
fq.ultimate-usb.54: Tap Pick ISO and choose the Windows ISO. The app reads the file.
fq.ultimate-usb.55: If the app shows the Windows type, keep Standard Windows Installation. Choose the Partition Table and File System, and set the Windows Setup Customization options you want.
fq.ultimate-usb.56: Tap START. The app shows All Data Will Be Permanently Deleted and the tokens it uses. Tap OK.
fq.ultimate-usb.57: A Windows ISO written this way uses 2 tokens (none with Pro). Keep the app in front until it finishes.
fq.ultimate-usb.58: How do I install Windows 11 on a PC without TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot?
fq.ultimate-usb.59: In ISO Burner, keep Remove requirement for 4GB+ RAM, Secure Boot and TPM 2.0. ticked in the Windows Setup Customization card. It is shown for Windows 11 images and is on by default for a standard installation. The card is not shown when the image has its own unattend file.
fq.ultimate-usb.60: The same card can remove the online Microsoft account requirement, create a local account, skip the privacy questions, copy the regional options from your phone and turn off automatic BitLocker encryption.
fq.ultimate-usb.61: On a Ventoy drive, use Config Hub → Boot → Windows 11: bypass hardware checks instead.
fq.ultimate-usb.62: My Windows ISO has a file over 4 GB. Can I still use FAT32?
fq.ultimate-usb.63: Yes. That file is install.wim. In ISO Burner, tick Split image for FAT32 compatibility. in the Advanced File System card. The app splits the file into parts so the drive can stay FAT32, and Windows setup puts the parts back together. Splitting takes a long time.
fq.ultimate-usb.64: The option is shown when the image can be split, the drive is 2 TB or smaller and Windows To Go is not chosen. Without it, the app uses NTFS for an image with a file over 4 GB. On a Ventoy drive the ISO is copied as one file, so use exFAT or NTFS there.
fq.ultimate-usb.65: What is Windows To Go, and where is the option?
fq.ultimate-usb.66: Windows To Go puts a portable Windows 10 or 11 on the USB drive, which then runs from the drive. It is not an installer.
fq.ultimate-usb.67: In ISO Burner, pick a Windows ISO that supports it, then choose Windows To Go instead of Standard Windows Installation. If the image has more than one edition, choose the edition from the list; the app selects a Pro edition first. Windows To Go uses NTFS.
fq.ultimate-usb.68: It can take several hours. Use a fast phone and a fast USB drive, turn on High-speed mode, and start with a fully charged phone.
fq.ultimate-usb.69: Can I write a bootable drive with NTFS?
fq.ultimate-usb.70: Yes. For Windows images ISO Burner offers FAT32 and NTFS. NTFS is set and locked for Windows To Go, for an image with a file over 4 GB (unless you split it) and for a drive over 2 TB. FAT32 is locked when the image's boot loader cannot read NTFS.
fq.ultimate-usb.71: Ventoy offers FAT32, exFAT and NTFS, and NTFS is the default.
fq.ultimate-usb.72: How do I put several ISO files on one USB drive?
fq.ultimate-usb.73: Use Ventoy - Unofficial. You install Ventoy once, copy ISO files to the drive, and pick one from a menu when the PC starts.
fq.ultimate-usb.74: Connect the drive and open Ventoy - Unofficial.
fq.ultimate-usb.75: Choose the options and tap Install. This erases the drive and uses 2 tokens.
fq.ultimate-usb.76: Tap Copy File To USB to copy an ISO file, or Download File Directly To USB FROM INTERNET to save one straight to the drive. Both are free, and the app checks the free space first.
fq.ultimate-usb.77: To remove an ISO, delete it in USB File Manager. Ventoy can be installed only on drives with 512-byte sectors.
fq.ultimate-usb.78: Can I use a specific Ventoy version?
fq.ultimate-usb.79: Yes. One Ventoy version is built into the app. Tap the version next to Ventoy In Package: to open the Ventoy version sheet.
fq.ultimate-usb.80: The built-in version is selected by default.
fq.ultimate-usb.81: Other version… shows the list of Ventoy releases. Tap a version and confirm the download.
fq.ultimate-usb.82: Downloaded versions show On this phone and can be deleted.
fq.ultimate-usb.83: The version you select is used for both Install and Update. If a downloaded version cannot be used, nothing is written to the drive and the tokens come back.
fq.ultimate-usb.85: How long does a write take, and why can it be slow?
fq.ultimate-usb.86: The speed depends on the USB drive and on the phone's USB port. A USB 3.0 drive in a USB 2.0 adapter runs at USB 2.0 speed, and many small files write much slower than one large file. Large drives and large images take time.
fq.ultimate-usb.87: In ISO Burner, High-speed mode. (Recommended) is on when the phone has enough free storage for it. Windows To Go can take several hours. Benchmark measures the real speed of your drive.
fq.ultimate-usb.88: Why did the write stop at a percentage or the app close during the write?
fq.ultimate-usb.89: The app was minimised. A job pauses while the app is in the background and continues when it is in front again.
fq.ultimate-usb.90: No internet or an ad blocker (free version). Running jobs wait until this is fixed. Pro does not pause for these.
fq.ultimate-usb.91: The drive was removed or stopped answering. During a burn (ISO Burner or Raw Write), a backup or a restore, the app shows Device Removed with Retry. Plug the same drive back in and tap Retry: most jobs continue where they stopped. A different drive is never written. If you cancel instead, the tokens come back. Other jobs end as failed: reconnect the drive and start again; the tokens come back.
fq.ultimate-usb.92: A stop near the very end often means the drive reports more space than it has, or its flash fails at the end. Run Bad Blocks Check with Detect fake / counterfeit capacity ticked (it erases the drive).
fq.ultimate-usb.93: If the app was closed during a job, the tokens come back the next time you open it.
fq.ultimate-usb.94: Can I use other apps while a write is running?
fq.ultimate-usb.95: No. Jobs pause when the app leaves the foreground, to protect the drive. Keep the app open and in front until the job finishes. The app keeps the screen on while it is shown. Start long jobs when you do not need the phone.
fq.ultimate-usb.96: My PC does not boot from the USB drive. What should I check?
fq.ultimate-usb.97: Boot menu: select the USB drive in the PC's boot menu (often F12, F11, F9 or Esc at power-on).
fq.ultimate-usb.98: Secure Boot: turn it off in the BIOS/UEFI, or use a drive that supports it. Ventoy has a Secure Boot Support option.
fq.ultimate-usb.99: Partition scheme: GPT drives need UEFI mode; MBR drives need legacy or CSM mode.
fq.ultimate-usb.100: USB port: try a port directly on the motherboard, not on the front panel or a hub.
fq.ultimate-usb.101: The ISO: download it again from the official source. A truncated ISO writes without error but does not boot. ISO Burner warns when an ISO looks truncated.
fq.ultimate-usb.102: My drive shows less space after writing. How do I get the full capacity back?
fq.ultimate-usb.103: A bootable write can leave hidden partitions. Format USB makes the whole drive one partition again. In Partition Wizard you can delete the partitions and create one across the drive. On a Ventoy drive, Clear removes Ventoy.
fq.ultimate-usb.104: Drive makers count in decimal gigabytes and phones in binary ones, so a "64 GB" drive holds about 59 GiB. A large shortfall can mean a counterfeit drive.
fq.ultimate-usb.105: Can the app damage my USB drive?
fq.ultimate-usb.106: No. Nothing the app does is unrecoverable at the hardware level; the worst case is a drive that needs formatting again. If a drive stopped working after an operation, it was already failing.
fq.ultimate-usb.107: The app tests each drive when it is connected and asks for confirmation before it erases one. Every job that formats the drive (Format USB, ISO Burner, Ventoy Install, Partition Wizard Create and Format, and the PS2 drive format) checks and tests the file system before the app reports success.
fq.ultimate-usb.108: Is the app safe, and is my data uploaded anywhere?
fq.ultimate-usb.109: Your files are processed on your phone, and their contents are never uploaded. There is no account and no sign-up. What the app does send, such as ad requests, crash reports and purchase checks, is listed in its privacy policy.
fq.ultimate-usb.110: The Windows setup options you enter do not leave the phone. The erasure certificate is made on your phone and goes nowhere unless you share it.
fq.ultimate-usb.112: Can the app repair a drive that no longer formats?
fq.ultimate-usb.113: Not in place. A broken partition table or file system is usually fixed by formatting fresh with Format USB or Wipe USB, so copy off what you need first. Recover deleted files only reads the drive.
fq.ultimate-usb.114: If a format fails its check, the drive has a hardware fault. Run Bad Blocks Check to confirm it (it erases the drive); if it reports errors, replace the drive.
fq.ultimate-usb.115: Can I recover deleted files from a USB drive?
fq.ultimate-usb.116: Yes. Open Recover deleted files and tap Start scan. It works with FAT12, FAT16, FAT32, exFAT, NTFS and ext2/3/4 drives and can find 201 file types. The scan only reads the drive and uses no tokens.
fq.ultimate-usb.117: Tap a file to preview or check it, tick the files you want and tap Recover. They are saved on the phone in Downloads/Ultimate USB Recovery, in a new folder named by date and time. A USB drive or memory card cannot be the target.
fq.ultimate-usb.118: You can pause or stop the scan; it is saved so you can continue later. If the drive is unplugged, the scan pauses and continues when the same drive is plugged in again. To find lost partitions, use Recover lost partitions.
fq.ultimate-usb.119: How do I check a drive for bad blocks and test its speed?
fq.ultimate-usb.120: Bad Blocks Check tests the whole drive. Choose 1 Pass or 2 Passes, keep Detect fake / counterfeit capacity ticked and tap START. It erases all data on the drive. It uses no tokens.
fq.ultimate-usb.121: Benchmark measures sequential and random speed. Choose the Mode: (Sequential, Random or Both) and the Type: (Read Only or Read / Write), then tap START. It uses no tokens. In Read / Write mode, Benchmark leaves your files as they were.
fq.ultimate-usb.122: How do I securely wipe a drive and get a certificate?

fq.ultimate-usb.136: Make ISO has Split into 4 GB parts (for FAT32 drives), and Extract ISO has Split files over 4 GB into parts (for FAT32 drives).
fq.ultimate-usb.138: How do I copy many files at once with the file manager?

fq.usb-file-manager.31: Yes, you can pause, resume or stop any operation. Copies run one after another in a queue, with live progress, speed and time left. When a file with the same name exists, choose replace, skip or keep both, for one file or for all.

fq.usb-tools.93: My PC does not boot from the USB drive. What should I check?

fq.usb-tools.96: Secure Boot: turn it off in the BIOS/UEFI, or use a drive that supports it.
fq.usb-tools.97: Partition scheme: GPT drives need UEFI mode; MBR drives need legacy or CSM mode.
fq.usb-tools.98: USB port: try a port directly on the motherboard, not on the front panel or a hub.
fq.usb-tools.99: Can the app damage my USB drive?
fq.usb-tools.100: No. Nothing the app does is unrecoverable at the hardware level; the worst case is a drive that needs formatting again. If a drive stopped working after an operation, it was already failing.
fq.usb-tools.101: The app tests each drive when it is connected and asks for confirmation before it erases one. Every job that formats the drive (Format USB, Partition Wizard Create and Format, and the PS2 drive format) checks and tests the file system before the app reports success.

fq.usb-tools.106: How do I add PS2 games for OPL, and which format should I convert to?

fq.usb-tools.109: PS1 games: Import VCD Game accepts .VCD files for POPStarter; the POPS system file must be supplied by you. Game Converter converts between ISO, BIN/CUE, VCD, ZSO, CSO and CHD. OPL needs unfragmented files, so tap Defragment if needed.

fq.usb-tools.111: If a card reader has no card in it, the app says that there is no card or disk in the drive.

fq.usb-tools.113: A short connection failure. It does not stop the job: the app tries again and goes on.
fq.usb-tools.114: A drive that is write-protected, or one that does not take writes, is refused at the start with one message, before any question and before any token is used.

fq.ventoy.7: Free: Copy File To USB, downloading files to the drive, USB File Manager, Theme Manager, Config Hub and persistence images.
fq.ventoy.8: To earn a token, tap the token counter on the main screen to open Get Tokens, then tap Watch under Get 1 free token. One short rewarded video (60 seconds at most) gives 1 token. fq.ventoy.9: What happens to my tokens when a write does not complete?
fq.ventoy.10: They come back automatically. Tokens are taken when you tap OK, before the job starts. If Install, Update or Clear fails, or nothing was written, the app gives them back.
fq.ventoy.11: If the app is closed during a job, the tokens come back the next time you open the app. Install, Update and Clear have no Cancel button.
fq.ventoy.12: Why does the rewarded ad not load, and what can I do to still earn a token?
fq.ventoy.13: This is nearly always the network. Try these in order:
fq.ventoy.14: Private DNS: open Settings, search for Private DNS, choose Private DNS provider hostname and enter dns.google. Save, switch the connection off and on, then restart the app.
fq.ventoy.15: Turn off ad blockers and blocking VPNs for the app.
fq.ventoy.16: Switch between Wi-Fi and mobile data.
fq.ventoy.17: Watch the ad to the end and close it with the X. Pressing Back early cancels the reward.
fq.ventoy.18: If the ad finished and the balance did not change, force-stop the app (Settings → Apps → the app → Force stop) and open it again while online. You can also buy tokens, or get Pro, which turns the token system off.
fq.ventoy.19: Why does the app say an ad blocker or private DNS is active?
fq.ventoy.20: The free version cannot load its ads through an ad blocker, a blocking VPN or ad-blocking Private DNS. Running operations wait until it is switched off for the app. Set Private DNS to dns.google or turn it off, then restart the app.
fq.ventoy.21: Pro, or any token pack you bought on this install, lets the app run with an ad blocker on.
fq.ventoy.22: Why does the app need an internet connection?
fq.ventoy.23: Installing Ventoy does not need it. The free version needs a connection to load ads, which pay for the free tools. While you are offline it shows No Internet Connection and running operations wait. They continue on their own when you are back online.
fq.ventoy.24: Pro works offline. Downloading files to the drive and loading other Ventoy versions need the internet in any case.
fq.ventoy.25: Can I pay instead of watching ads, and what does a purchase include?
fq.ventoy.26: Yes. You can buy tokens, or buy Pro. Pro is a one-time, lifetime purchase with no subscription. It removes all ads, turns the token system off, and lets you use the app offline and with an ad blocker on. The Ventoy features are the same with and without Pro.
fq.ventoy.28: Why is my USB drive not detected (USB-C drive, card reader, OTG adapter)?
fq.ventoy.29: The phone has to detect the drive first. Work through this list:
fq.ventoy.30: Open the phone's Settings, search for OTG and switch it on if the option exists.
fq.ventoy.31: Use a data OTG adapter. Charge-only cables cannot carry data.
fq.ventoy.32: When Android asks whether the app may use the USB device, tap OK. If you refused, unplug the drive and plug it in again. Check that the mode on the main screen is USB OTG, not SD Slot.
fq.ventoy.33: Plug in a FAT32 or exFAT drive and check that the phone notices it. If even that drive is not noticed, the cause is the cable, the port or the drive.
fq.ventoy.34: Test the drive on a PC, and check the phone's port for dust.
fq.ventoy.35: If the phone does not recognise the drive after Ventoy was installed, it is likely working: test it on a PC.
fq.ventoy.37: No, not for USB drives over OTG. Root is needed only for the phone's internal SD card slot. Without root, put the card in a USB card reader and connect it over OTG.
fq.ventoy.38: Can I use an NTFS drive on Android?
fq.ventoy.39: Yes. The app's USB File Manager opens FAT, exFAT, NTFS and EXT drives, also when the phone itself cannot read them. NTFS is the default file system for a Ventoy drive.
fq.ventoy.40: Android may say the drive is damaged or unsupported. That is expected: many phones cannot read NTFS on their own. Dismiss the notice and do not tap Android's offer to format: it would erase the drive.
fq.ventoy.41: Why does Ventoy refuse my drive?
fq.ventoy.42: Ventoy supports only drives with 512-byte sectors. A drive with 4096-byte sectors (4K native) is refused with a message that says so.
fq.ventoy.43: The app also checks the drive when you connect it. If reading or writing at the end of the drive fails, the drive may be faulty or counterfeit (smaller than it claims), and the app asks whether to Scan for real size or Continue anyway. The scan finds the size the drive really stores; tap Yes to use it. If you keep the claimed size, Install and Clear warn you once, with Continue and Cancel, before anything is written and before any token is used.
fq.ventoy.45: How do I put several ISO files on one USB drive?
fq.ventoy.46: Install Ventoy once, then copy ISO, WIM, IMG, VHD or EFI files to the drive. When the PC starts, you pick one from the Ventoy menu.
fq.ventoy.47: Connect the drive. The Ventoy screen opens when you start the app.
fq.ventoy.48: Choose *Partition Table:, *File System: and the other options, and tap Install.
fq.ventoy.49: The app shows The disk will be formatted and all data will be lost. and the tokens. Tap OK.
fq.ventoy.50: When it is done, copy your ISO files to the drive with Copy File To USB.
fq.ventoy.52: Can I install Ventoy with GPT, or only MBR?
fq.ventoy.53: Both. Choose MBR or GPT under *Partition Table:, then tap Install. MBR is the default; on a drive over 2 TB, GPT is set and locked.
fq.ventoy.54: Install erases the drive, including ISO files already on it, so copy them back afterwards. Update keeps your ISO files and keeps the drive's partition style.
fq.ventoy.55: How do I copy ISO files onto a Ventoy drive?
fq.ventoy.56: Tap Copy File To USB and pick the file with the system file picker, or tap Download File Directly To USB FROM INTERNET to save a download straight to the drive. Both are free. Copying the files on a PC works too.
fq.ventoy.57: The app checks the free space first and shows Not Enough Space. when the file does not fit. When a file with the same name exists, it asks File already exists. Replace it? To remove an ISO, delete it in USB File Manager.
fq.ventoy.58: Why does the PC say no bootable file was found on the Ventoy drive?
fq.ventoy.59: Check that Ventoy In Device: shows a version. If it is empty, Ventoy is not on the drive.
fq.ventoy.60: Check that the file is one Ventoy can boot: ISO, WIM, IMG, VHD or EFI.
fq.ventoy.61: Download the file again if the copy may be incomplete. A truncated ISO copies without error but does not boot.
fq.ventoy.62: In Config Hub → Boot, the sections Finding images (Search root, Max search depth) and Hide from the menu (for example Hide .iso files in menu) change which files the menu lists. Check them if a file is missing.
fq.ventoy.63: How do I choose which ISO boots at startup?
fq.ventoy.64: When the PC starts from the drive, Ventoy shows a menu of the files on it, and you pick one.
fq.ventoy.65: To set a default, open Config Hub → Boot and set Default boot entry and Menu timeout (whole seconds, 0 to 3600). Default menu mode switches between List and TreeView. After you save, the app shows Saved. Takes effect on next boot.
fq.ventoy.66: Can I use a specific Ventoy version?
fq.ventoy.67: Yes. One Ventoy version is built into the app. Tap the version next to Ventoy In Package: to open the Ventoy version sheet.
fq.ventoy.68: The built-in version is selected by default.
fq.ventoy.69: Other version… shows the list of Ventoy releases. Tap a version and confirm the download.
fq.ventoy.70: Downloaded versions show On this phone and can be deleted.
fq.ventoy.71: The version you select is used for both Install and Update. If a downloaded version cannot be used, nothing is written to the drive and the tokens come back.
fq.ventoy.72: Can I theme or password-protect a Ventoy drive?
fq.ventoy.73: Yes. Theme Manager imports a GRUB2 theme archive (zip, tar.gz or tar.xz) onto the drive. Config Hub sets a boot-menu password, menu options and persistence in the drive's ventoy.json file. Both are free, and the settings are written only to the drive.
fq.ventoy.75: How do I make a bootable Windows USB from my phone?
fq.ventoy.76: Install Ventoy on the drive, then copy the Windows ISO to it with Copy File To USB. When the PC starts from the drive, pick the ISO in the Ventoy menu.
fq.ventoy.77: The ISO is copied as one file, and FAT32 cannot hold a single file over 4 GB. For an ISO over 4 GB, use exFAT or NTFS for the drive.
fq.ventoy.78: How do I install Windows 11 on a PC without TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot?
fq.ventoy.79: Open Config Hub → Boot and turn on Windows 11: bypass hardware checks. Windows 11: bypass online account removes the online-account requirement. Save; the change takes effect on the next boot.
fq.ventoy.80: Can I copy an ISO with a file over 4 GB to a FAT32 Ventoy drive?
fq.ventoy.81: No. FAT32 cannot hold a single file over 4 GB, and on a Ventoy drive the ISO is copied as one file. Use exFAT or NTFS for the drive. The app checks the free space before it copies.
fq.ventoy.83: How long does a write take, and why can it be slow?
fq.ventoy.84: The speed depends on the whole chain: a USB 3.0 drive in a USB 2.0 adapter runs at USB 2.0 speed, and many small files write much slower than one large file. Large drives and large ISO files take time.
fq.ventoy.85: Why did the write stop at a percentage or the app close during the write?

fq.ventoy.87: No internet or an ad blocker (free version). Running jobs wait until this is fixed. Pro does not pause for these.
fq.ventoy.88: The drive was removed or stopped answering. The job ends as failed. Reconnect the drive and start again; the tokens come back.
fq.ventoy.89: A stop near the very end often means the drive reports more space than it has, or its flash fails at the end. Reconnect the drive: if the end of the drive fails the check, the app asks whether to Scan for real size or Continue anyway.
fq.ventoy.90: If the app was closed during a job, the tokens come back the next time you open it.
fq.ventoy.91: Can I use other apps while a write is running?
fq.ventoy.92: No. Jobs pause when the app leaves the foreground, to protect the drive. Keep the app open and in front until the job finishes. The app keeps the screen on while it is shown.
fq.ventoy.93: My PC does not boot from the USB drive. What should I check?
fq.ventoy.94: Boot menu: select the USB drive in the PC's boot menu (often F12, F11, F9 or Esc at power-on).
fq.ventoy.95: Secure Boot: keep Secure Boot Support ticked when you install (it is on by default), or turn Secure Boot off in the BIOS/UEFI.
fq.ventoy.96: Partition scheme: GPT drives need UEFI mode; MBR drives need legacy or CSM mode.
fq.ventoy.97: USB port: try a port directly on the motherboard, not on the front panel or a hub.
fq.ventoy.98: The ISO: download it again from the official source. A truncated ISO copies without error but does not boot.
fq.ventoy.99: My drive shows less space after writing. How do I get the full capacity back?
fq.ventoy.100: Tap Clear to remove Ventoy from the drive (1 token). It formats the drive, so copy off your files first.
fq.ventoy.101: Drive makers count in decimal gigabytes and phones in binary ones, so a "64 GB" drive holds about 59 GiB. A large shortfall can mean a counterfeit drive.

fq.ventoy.104: The app tests each drive when it is connected, refuses drives Ventoy does not support, and asks for confirmation before Install or Clear erases a drive. Update does not format the drive.
fq.ventoy.105: Is the app safe, and is my data uploaded anywhere?
fq.ventoy.106: Your files are processed on your phone, and their contents are never uploaded. There is no account and no sign-up. Config Hub and theme settings are written only to the drive. What the app does send, such as ad requests, crash reports and purchase checks, is listed in its privacy policy.

gd.choose-usb-app.1: Does it test the drive for fake capacity before writing?
gd.choose-usb-app.2: A counterfeit drive reports more space than it has, and a write to it fails or loses data. A safe app checks the drive before it writes.
gd.choose-usb-app.3: Ultimate USB, DROFUS and Ventoy (Unofficial) check each drive when you connect it. If reading or writing at the end of the drive fails, the drive may be fake or faulty, and they ask whether to Scan for real size or Continue anyway. After a scan, every tool works inside the real size. No tool refuses such a drive: if you keep the claimed size, every write warns you once before anything is written. For a full test of the whole drive, Ultimate USB has Bad Blocks Check.
gd.choose-usb-app.4: Does it warn before erasing the drive?
gd.choose-usb-app.5: Writing a bootable drive erases it, so the app should ask first. Ultimate USB and DROFUS show All Data Will Be Permanently Deleted before ISO Burner and Raw Write start. Ultimate USB and Ventoy (Unofficial) show The disk will be formatted and all data will be lost. before Ventoy Install or Clear. You confirm with OK or stop with Cancel.
gd.choose-usb-app.6: Does it detect a truncated, corrupted or non-bootable image?
gd.choose-usb-app.7: An ISO from an interrupted download writes without error but does not boot. In Ultimate USB and DROFUS, ISO Burner warns when an ISO looks truncated or corrupted and when the selected file is not a bootable image. It refuses images that are incomplete or damaged and asks you to download them again.
gd.choose-usb-app.8: Does it check the free space first?
gd.choose-usb-app.9: In Ultimate USB and DROFUS, ISO Burner checks that the drive is large enough and, in High-speed mode, that the phone has enough free storage before it starts. In Ultimate USB and Ventoy (Unofficial), Copy File To USB and downloads to a Ventoy drive check the free space on the drive and show Not Enough Space. when the file does not fit.
gd.choose-usb-app.10: Does it give tokens back when a write does not complete?
gd.choose-usb-app.11: If an app charges for a write, a failed write should not cost you. In Ultimate USB, DROFUS and Ventoy (Unofficial), the tokens come back when a paid job fails, when a burn or a format is cancelled, and when nothing was written. If the app is closed during a job, the tokens come back the next time it opens.
gd.choose-usb-app.12: Does it offer GPT or MBR, and NTFS, FAT32 or exFAT?
gd.choose-usb-app.13: The partition table must match how the PC starts: GPT for UEFI, MBR for legacy BIOS or CSM.
gd.choose-usb-app.14: Ultimate USB and DROFUS (ISO Burner): GPT (UEFI) or MBR (BIOS or UEFI-CSM); FAT32 or NTFS for bootable images, and FAT32, exFAT or NTFS for a Non-bootable drive.
gd.choose-usb-app.15: Ultimate USB and Ventoy (Unofficial) (Ventoy): MBR or GPT, and FAT32, exFAT or NTFS.
gd.choose-usb-app.16: Can it split install.wim for FAT32?
gd.choose-usb-app.17: Many PCs with Secure Boot need a FAT32 drive, but FAT32 cannot hold a file over 4 GB. Ultimate USB and DROFUS offer Split image for FAT32 compatibility., which splits install.wim into parts. Windows setup puts the parts back together.
gd.choose-usb-app.18: Can you pick the exact Windows edition?
gd.choose-usb-app.19: In Ultimate USB and DROFUS, when you write Windows To Go from an image with more than one edition, the app lists the editions and you choose one.
gd.choose-usb-app.20: Can you pick the Ventoy version?
gd.choose-usb-app.21: In Ultimate USB and Ventoy (Unofficial), the Ventoy version sheet lists the built-in version, versions you downloaded, and Other version…, which lists more Ventoy releases. The version you select is used for Install and Update.
gd.choose-usb-app.22: Does it check the file system after formatting?
gd.choose-usb-app.23: In Ultimate USB, DROFUS and Ventoy (Unofficial), every job that formats a drive checks and tests the file system afterwards and only then reports success. This includes Format USB, ISO Burner and Ventoy Install. If a check fails, the job is reported as failed.
gd.choose-usb-app.24: Does it work on your phone with no account?
gd.choose-usb-app.25: Your files and images should stay on your phone. In Ultimate USB, DROFUS and Ventoy (Unofficial), files are processed on the phone and their contents are never uploaded, and there is no account or sign-up. The free versions need an internet connection for ads, and running jobs wait while the phone is offline; Pro works offline.
