tl.ps3-iso-tools.1: How do I use PS3 ISO TOOLS step by step?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.3: Open the Gaming Tools group and tap PS3 ISO TOOLS.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.4: Tap the action you need: Split ISO, Split PKG, Join ISO, Join PKG, Extract ISO, Make ISO, Modify ISO, Patch ISO or Info ISO.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.5: Pick the source file or folder, set the options, and pick where the result goes.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.6: How do I split a PS3 ISO or PKG for a FAT32 drive?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.7: Tap Split ISO or Split PKG, pick the .iso or .pkg file, choose the Split options, then pick the output folder.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.12: 1 GB, 2 GB, 3 GB, or Custom… with Size in MB (16 MB to 3 GB)
tl.ps3-iso-tools.14: Place parts in a folder named after the file
tl.ps3-iso-tools.17: PKG parts are named .66600, .66601 and so on. If the file is smaller than the part size, the app tells you. If you cancel, the parts that are already finished are kept.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.18: How do I join split parts back into one file?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.19: Tap Join ISO or Join PKG, pick the folder of the split set and its first part. If a part is missing, the app tells you the set is incomplete.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.20: How do I extract a PS3 ISO?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.21: Tap Extract ISO and pick the ISO. Tick Split files over 4 GB into parts (for FAT32 drives) if the files go to a FAT32 drive; it is off by default. Split files get the endings .666NN.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.22: How do I make an ISO from a game folder?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.23: Tap Make ISO and pick the game folder. The folder must contain PS3_GAME/PARAM.SFO and can have up to 4096 folders. Tick Split into 4 GB parts (for FAT32 drives) if you need parts; it is off by default.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.24: How do I rename an ISO or add tags?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.25: Tap Modify ISO and choose one or more of the ISO-Modify-Options. All are off by default; if you choose none, the app tells you.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.30: How do I patch an ISO for my CFW version?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.31: Tap Patch ISO, pick the ISO, and set the Target CFW version. The default is 4.76. The app accepts versions from 4.21 up to, but not including, 4.90.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.32: How do I see the game details of an ISO?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.33: Tap Info ISO and pick the ISO. The app shows Title, Title ID, Version, App Version, Category, Parental Level, Required Firmware and Resolution.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.34: Does PS3 ISO TOOLS use tokens?
tl.ps3-iso-tools.35: No. Every action in PS3 ISO TOOLS is free.
tl.ps3-iso-tools.desc: Open PS3 ISO TOOLS in Ultimate USB or USB Tools. It makes an ISO from a game folder, extracts an ISO, splits and joins ISO and PKG files for FAT32 drives, patches the target CFW version, adds tags and shows the game info. It uses no tokens.

tl.raw-write.1: How do I write a disk image step by step?
tl.raw-write.2: Connect the drive to your phone with a USB OTG adapter and open Ultimate USB.
tl.raw-write.3: Open the Bootable & Image Writing group and tap Raw Write.
tl.raw-write.4: Next to RAW File:, tap Pick File and choose the image (for example an .img file) in the system file picker.
tl.raw-write.5: Tap START. The app shows All Data Will Be Permanently Deleted. Tap OK to start.
tl.raw-write.6: The app shows Writing and the progress. Keep the app in front until it finishes.
tl.raw-write.7: Raw Write has no options: the drive gets an exact copy of the file. To make an installer from a Windows or Linux ISO with partition, file system and setup options, use ISO Burner.
tl.raw-write.8: What does the app check before it writes?
tl.raw-write.9: If the file is larger than the drive, the app shows Not Enough Size… and does not write.
tl.raw-write.10: When you connect a drive, the app checks it. If reading or writing at the end of the drive fails, it may be fake or faulty, and the app asks whether to Scan for real size or Continue anyway.
tl.raw-write.11: Nothing is written before you confirm All Data Will Be Permanently Deleted.
tl.raw-write.12: How many tokens does Raw Write use?
tl.raw-write.13: None. Raw Write is free and uses no tokens.
tl.raw-write.14: What happens if the write is interrupted?
tl.raw-write.15: When the app goes to the background, the write pauses, and it continues when you come back to the app. The app keeps the screen on while it is shown.
tl.raw-write.16: In the free version, the write also pauses while the phone has no internet connection or an ad blocker or blocking Private DNS is active, and continues when that is fixed. With Pro, only the background pause applies.
tl.raw-write.17: If a write error happens, the app offers Retry to go on with the write.
tl.raw-write.18: To stop the write, cancel it and answer Are you sure you want to cancel the process?
tl.raw-write.19: If the drive is unplugged or stops answering, the app shows Device Removed with Retry. Plug the same drive back in and tap Retry: the write continues where it stopped. A different drive is never written.
tl.raw-write.20: Is Raw Write safe for my drive?
tl.raw-write.21: Yes. The app waits until the drive confirms the data is written before it reports success, and it protects the drive at each step:
tl.raw-write.22: A drive that is write-protected or does not take writes is recognised as soon as you start a job: one clear message, and nothing is charged.
tl.raw-write.23: If the drive did not keep its test data, it may be fake. The app says so, keeps its files read-only and offers Try restore again. Raw Write still runs after an extra Yes.
tl.raw-write.24: A job never writes to a different drive than the one it started on.
tl.raw-write.25: If the USB connection fails for a moment during a job, the app recovers it automatically and the job continues.
tl.raw-write.26: More than five years of building USB apps, and over 1,000,000 downloads on Google Play for Ultimate USB.
tl.raw-write.27: Read more: How our USB apps keep your drive and your data safe.
tl.raw-write.desc: Open Raw Write in Ultimate USB, tap Pick File, choose the image and tap START. The app writes the file onto the USB drive exactly as it is. Raw Write uses no tokens.

tl.recover-files.1: How do I recover deleted files step by step?
tl.recover-files.2: Connect the drive to your phone with a USB OTG adapter and open Ultimate USB or USB Tools.
tl.recover-files.3: Open the Data Recovery group and tap Recover deleted files.
tl.recover-files.5: Tap Start scan. The app shows how much it has read and about how much time is left.
tl.recover-files.6: Look through the results. Tap a file to preview it.
tl.recover-files.7: Tick the files you want (or Select all). Tap Change folder if you want another folder on the phone.
tl.recover-files.8: Tap Recover, then Save. When it is done, the app shows Files saved; tap Open folder to see them.
tl.recover-files.9: The scan only reads the drive. Nothing is written to it while it is scanned.
tl.recover-files.10: Which scan does the app run?
tl.recover-files.11: One scan, the Smart scan. There is no scan mode to choose. Some results are marked Found by content. Older saved scans may still show the names Quick scan, Deep scan (recommended) or Raw scan.
tl.recover-files.12: Which advanced options can I turn on?
tl.recover-files.15: Check every file found completely (slower, more reliable status)
tl.recover-files.16: Checks each file it finds in full, so the status of each file is more reliable. The scan takes longer.
tl.recover-files.17: Copy the whole drive to the phone first (for drives with read errors)
tl.recover-files.18: Copies the drive to the phone, then scans the copy. The phone needs enough free space for it. If you stop the copy, it is deleted from the phone.
tl.recover-files.19: Which drives and file types can it recover?
tl.recover-files.20: It reads FAT12, FAT16, FAT32, exFAT, NTFS, ext2, ext3 and ext4. It can find 201 file types, for example:
tl.recover-files.21: Photos: JPG, PNG, HEIC, PSD and camera RAW files such as CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW and DNG.
tl.recover-files.25: Archives and other files: ZIP, RAR, 7Z, ISO, APK, SQLite.
tl.recover-files.26: The results are sorted into tabs: All files, Photos, Videos, Music, Documents, Archives and Other.
tl.recover-files.27: How do I find the right files in the results?
tl.recover-files.28: Switch between By type and By folder, or use Search by name.
tl.recover-files.29: Sort by Chance of recovery (best first), Name, Size (largest first) or Date (newest first), and use Filter to narrow the list.
tl.recover-files.30: Each file has a label: Checked: opens, Good chance, May be damaged, Overwritten or Unknown.
tl.recover-files.31: Can I preview a file before I recover it?
tl.recover-files.32: Yes. Tap a file to open its preview. Pictures and text are shown, including camera RAW, TIFF and Photoshop files, and AVCHD video. For an archive the app shows how many items it holds. A file type without a preview shows No preview for this type of file.
tl.recover-files.33: In the preview you can tap Check file, Open in another app or Recover this file.
tl.recover-files.35: In the phone's Downloads folder, in Ultimate USB Recovery (or USB TOOLS Recovery in USB Tools), in a new folder named by the date and time.
tl.recover-files.36: Change folder picks another folder on the phone. A USB drive or a memory card cannot be chosen. If the phone has too little space, the app tells you. If you cancel saving, the files already saved stay.
tl.recover-files.37: Can I pause a scan and continue it later?
tl.recover-files.38: Yes. Pause stops reading for now. The app shows Pausing... until the scan has stopped.
tl.recover-files.39: Stop scan asks Stop the scan? The files found so far are kept, and the scan is saved so you can resume it later. Tap Keep scanning to go on instead.
tl.recover-files.40: Next time you open the tool with the same drive, Last scan of this drive offers Open, Continue scan and Delete.
tl.recover-files.41: If you leave the app, the scan is paused until the app is in front again. Without Pro, it is also paused while the phone is offline or an ad blocker is active.
tl.recover-files.42: If the drive is unplugged, the scan pauses; it is never cancelled. Plug the same drive in again, in any port, and the scan continues. Another drive is never read in its place.
tl.recover-files.43: How many tokens does recovery use?
tl.recover-files.44: None. Scanning and recovering files is free.
tl.recover-files.45: Lost a whole partition? Use Recover lost partitions.
tl.recover-files.46: If a saved scan cannot be continued, the app tells you.
tl.recover-files.47: If the folder you save into is removed, the recovered files are not lost.
tl.recover-files.desc: Open Recover deleted files in Ultimate USB or USB Tools and tap Start scan. The scan only reads the drive. Preview what it finds, tick the files and tap Recover: they are saved on your phone in Downloads. It reads 8 file systems, can find 201 file types and uses no tokens.

tl.recover-partitions.1: How do I recover a lost partition step by step?
tl.recover-partitions.2: Connect the drive to your phone with a USB OTG adapter and open Ultimate USB or USB Tools.
tl.recover-partitions.3: Open the Data Recovery group and tap Recover lost partitions.
tl.recover-partitions.4: Tap Search for partitions. What it finds is listed under Partitions found.
tl.recover-partitions.5: For a partition in the list, choose Browse files or Put back (see below).
tl.recover-partitions.6: Browse files or Put back: which one?
tl.recover-partitions.10: Shows the files of the partition. Tick the ones you want and tap Recover to copy them to your phone. The drive is not changed.
tl.recover-partitions.12: Writes the partition back into the drive's partition table.
tl.recover-partitions.13: What does Put back change, and can I undo it?
tl.recover-partitions.14: Only the partition table. The app asks Put this partition back? and explains: only the drive's partition table is written; the partition's data is not touched. The old table is saved first, so you can undo this.
tl.recover-partitions.16: When it is done, unplug the drive and connect it again.
tl.recover-partitions.17: To go back, tap Undo. The app writes the old table back.
tl.recover-partitions.18: If the partition table is damaged, the app offers Write a new partition table.
tl.recover-partitions.19: Why can a partition not be put back?
tl.recover-partitions.20: The app refuses Put back and tells you the reason when the found partition:
tl.recover-partitions.21: overlaps a partition that is in use,
tl.recover-partitions.24: does not start on a sector boundary,
tl.recover-partitions.25: is too large for this partition table,
tl.recover-partitions.26: lies outside the area the partition table can use.
tl.recover-partitions.27: A partition found inside an ISO or disk image can only be copied, not put back. In these cases you can still use Browse files to copy the files to your phone.
tl.recover-partitions.28: What if no partition is found?
tl.recover-partitions.29: The app offers Search for deleted files, which looks for single files instead. See Recover deleted files.
tl.recover-partitions.30: How many tokens does it use?
tl.recover-partitions.31: None. Searching for partitions, copying files and putting partitions back are free.
tl.recover-partitions.32: Can I stop a search or unplug the drive?
tl.recover-partitions.33: When you stop a search, the app tells you whether it can be resumed later.
tl.recover-partitions.34: If you leave the app, the search is paused until the app is in front again. Without Pro, it is also paused while the phone is offline or an ad blocker is active.
tl.recover-partitions.35: If the drive is unplugged, the search pauses. Plug the same drive in again and it continues. Another drive is never read in its place.
tl.recover-partitions.desc: Open Recover lost partitions in Ultimate USB or USB Tools and tap Search for partitions. For a partition it finds, Browse files copies its files to your phone, and Put back writes it back into the partition table. You can undo it, and it uses no tokens.

tl.recover-partitions.title: Recover a lost partition on a USB drive on Android
tl.usb-defragmenter.1: How do I defragment a USB drive step by step?
tl.usb-defragmenter.2: Connect the drive to your phone with a USB OTG adapter and open Ultimate USB or USB Tools.
tl.usb-defragmenter.3: Open the Disk Management group and tap USB Defragmenter.
tl.usb-defragmenter.4: Partition: pick the partition. Only FAT32 and exFAT partitions are listed.
tl.usb-defragmenter.5: Tap START. The app goes through Scanning the drive…, Analyzing files…, Moving files… and Finishing…, and shows SUCCESS at the end.
tl.usb-defragmenter.6: If the drive has no FAT32 or exFAT partition, the app shows No Partitions Found!. If the drive is nearly full, it shows Low Free Space; tap Run Anyway to go on, or Cancel.
tl.usb-defragmenter.8: It puts the pieces of fragmented files back together. Open PS2 Loader (OPL) needs unfragmented game files. For PS2 games you can also defragment single games in PS2 USB Utils.
tl.usb-defragmenter.9: When does the defragmenter refuse to run?
tl.usb-defragmenter.10: It does not start, or it stops, and tells you why when:
tl.usb-defragmenter.11: the file table of the partition cannot be read,
tl.usb-defragmenter.12: the phone does not have enough memory,
tl.usb-defragmenter.13: the drive changed during the run,
tl.usb-defragmenter.14: the drive was not closed properly and has to be checked first,
tl.usb-defragmenter.15: the drive is smaller than it reports,
tl.usb-defragmenter.17: How many tokens does defragmenting use?
tl.usb-defragmenter.19: What if I stop it or unplug the drive?
tl.usb-defragmenter.20: To stop, tap cancel and confirm Are you sure you want to cancel the process?
tl.usb-defragmenter.21: If you leave the app, the data written so far is saved to the drive, and the run waits until you are back in the app.
tl.usb-defragmenter.22: If the drive is unplugged, the app shows The drive was disconnected. Files moved so far are safe. Plug it in and run Defragment again.
tl.usb-defragmenter.23: Where the drive can be repaired, the app offers its own check.
tl.usb-defragmenter.desc: Open USB Defragmenter in Ultimate USB or USB Tools, pick a FAT32 or exFAT partition and tap START. It uses no tokens, and if the drive is unplugged, the files moved so far are safe. It refuses a drive that is unsafe to defragment and says why.

tl.usb-encryption.1: How do I encrypt a USB drive step by step?
tl.usb-encryption.2: Connect the drive to your phone with a USB OTG adapter and open Ultimate USB.
tl.usb-encryption.3: Open the Disk Management group and tap USB Encryption. The app shows This drive is not encrypted.
tl.usb-encryption.4: Read the notes under Before you encrypt.
tl.usb-encryption.5: Type your password in Password and again in Confirm password. Show password shows what you typed. Use at least 8 characters; there are no other rules.
tl.usb-encryption.6: Type I UNDERSTAND in Type the words above (upper or lower case does not matter).
tl.usb-encryption.7: Tap Encrypt Drive. On Android 13 and newer the app may first ask to show notifications.
tl.usb-encryption.8: The app shows Everything on the drive will be deleted, and the drive will only be readable in Ultimate USB. and how many tokens encryption uses. Confirm to start.
tl.usb-encryption.9: Wait while Encrypting runs: Measuring this phone's speed…, Writing the encryption header… and Creating the file system….
tl.usb-encryption.10: Under the password fields, Password strength shows very weak, weak, fair, strong or very strong.
tl.usb-encryption.11: Inside the encryption, the drive gets an exFAT file system with the label ENCRYPTED. The app tests this new file system the same way as Format USB does.
tl.usb-encryption.12: How do I open an encrypted drive?
tl.usb-encryption.13: Connect the drive and open USB Encryption in Ultimate USB. The app shows This drive is encrypted.
tl.usb-encryption.14: Enter your password to unlock the drive.
tl.usb-encryption.15: Tap Open Files or Browse Files to work with your files.
tl.usb-encryption.16: The drive locks itself again when you leave the app for more than 3 seconds.
tl.usb-encryption.17: The encrypted drive can be read only in Ultimate USB.
tl.usb-encryption.18: How do I change the password?
tl.usb-encryption.19: Unlock the drive and tap Change Password. This is quick. The old password stops working immediately. Unlocking the drive and changing the password use no tokens; only encrypting uses one.
tl.usb-encryption.20: What if I forget the password?
tl.usb-encryption.21: The password cannot be recovered or reset; that is what protects the files. USB Encryption can only make the drive usable again by formatting it, which erases everything. While you still know the password, use Change Password.
tl.usb-encryption.22: How many tokens does encryption use?
tl.usb-encryption.23: Encrypt Drive uses 1 token. The app shows the cost before it starts, and you earn a token by watching one short rewarded video. With Pro, encryption uses no tokens.
tl.usb-encryption.24: The token comes back automatically when the encryption does not succeed, for example when the drive is missing or busy. If the app is closed during encryption, the token is returned the next time the app starts.
tl.usb-encryption.25: What happens if encryption is interrupted?
tl.usb-encryption.26: During encryption the app shows a notification that asks you not to unplug the drive. If encryption stops early:
tl.usb-encryption.27: If it stops right at the start, the drive looks like a blank drive.
tl.usb-encryption.28: If it stops later, the app shows Encryption did not finish. The drive has to be set up again before it can be used.
tl.usb-encryption.29: Is encryption safe for my drive?
tl.usb-encryption.30: Yes. The app tests the new encrypted drive before it reports success, and it protects the drive at each step:
tl.usb-encryption.31: A drive that is write-protected or does not take writes is recognised as soon as you start a job: one clear message, and nothing is charged.
tl.usb-encryption.32: If the drive did not keep its test data, it may be fake. The app says so, keeps its files read-only and offers Try restore again.
tl.usb-encryption.33: A job never writes to a different drive than the one it started on.
tl.usb-encryption.34: If the USB connection fails for a moment during a job, the app recovers it automatically and the job continues.

tl.ventoy.1: How do I install Ventoy step by step?
tl.ventoy.2: Connect the drive to your phone with a USB OTG adapter. Open Ventoy (Unofficial), or in Ultimate USB open the Bootable & Image Writing group and tap Ventoy - Unofficial.
tl.ventoy.3: Ventoy In Package: shows the Ventoy version the app will install. Ventoy In Device: shows the version already on the drive, and stays empty when there is none.
tl.ventoy.5: *File System: choose FAT32, EXFAT or NTFS.
tl.ventoy.6: *Cluster Size: keep the size the app selects, or pick another one from the list.
tl.ventoy.7: Tick or untick Secure Boot Support and *Align partitions with 4K.
tl.ventoy.8: Tap Install. The app shows The disk will be formatted and all data will be lost. and how many tokens the install uses. Tap OK to start.
tl.ventoy.9: Wait until the install finishes. The message then says Next: copy your ISO files to the drive.
tl.ventoy.10: Options marked with an asterisk (*) are used only by the install. When Ventoy is already on the drive, the screen shows that drive's partition table, file system, Secure Boot and alignment settings. After an install, the app confirms the Ventoy version on the drive.
tl.ventoy.11: Ventoy is built into the app and ready to install, and you can choose another Ventoy version (see below). Ventoy (Unofficial) is an independent app, not affiliated with the Ventoy project.
tl.ventoy.12: Which options can I set, and what are the defaults?
tl.ventoy.18: MBR (GPT is set and locked above 2 TB)
tl.ventoy.20: FAT32, exFAT, NTFS. FAT32 cannot be used above 2 TB.
tl.ventoy.23: The sizes allowed for the chosen file system and drive size
tl.ventoy.24: Chosen by the app for the file system and drive size (Default Value when the app cannot choose a size)
tl.ventoy.31: Ventoy needs a drive with 512-byte sectors. On a drive with 4096-byte sectors (4K native), the app says that Ventoy cannot be installed on this drive, and nothing is installed.
tl.ventoy.32: Can I install Ventoy with GPT, or only MBR?
tl.ventoy.33: Both. Choose MBR or GPT under *Partition Table: before you tap Install. Drives larger than 2 TB always use GPT.
tl.ventoy.34: To switch a Ventoy drive to the other partition table, install again. Install erases the whole drive, including the ISO files on it, so copy them back afterwards. Update keeps your ISO files but does not change the partition table.
tl.ventoy.35: How do I update Ventoy without losing my ISO files?
tl.ventoy.36: Connect the Ventoy drive and tap Update. The app shows Upgrade operation is safe, ISO files will be unchanged. and how many tokens the update uses. Tap OK.
tl.ventoy.37: Update does not format the drive and keeps its partition table. If Ventoy is not on the drive, the app shows Ventoy is not installed on this USB device. Please install it first. with the buttons Install and Close.
tl.ventoy.38: How do I remove Ventoy from a drive?
tl.ventoy.39: Tap Clear. The app shows The disk will be formatted and all data will be lost. and how many tokens it uses. Tap OK. Clear removes Ventoy and formats the drive, so the ISO files on it are deleted too.
tl.ventoy.40: How do I use another Ventoy version?
tl.ventoy.41: Tap the version next to Ventoy In Package: and choose it in the Ventoy version sheet. By default the app uses its built-in version.
tl.ventoy.42: The sheet lists the built-in version, each version you downloaded before with On this phone and its size, and Other version…. The version in use is marked Selected.
tl.ventoy.43: Tap Other version…. The app loads the list of Ventoy releases from GitHub. Each row shows Download with the size, or On this phone when you already have that version.
tl.ventoy.44: Tap a version. The app asks Download Ventoy … from GitHub? Confirm, and the app shows Checking Ventoy … while it checks the version.
tl.ventoy.45: Tap Install or Update. Both use the version you chose.
tl.ventoy.46: If the list does not load, the app shows Could not load the list. Try again later. If the chosen version cannot be used, the app shows This Ventoy version could not be used. Nothing was written to the drive. and the tokens come back. To remove a downloaded version from the phone, tap Delete next to it and confirm.
tl.ventoy.47: How do I copy ISO files onto a Ventoy drive?
tl.ventoy.48: Tap Copy File To USB and choose the file in the system file picker. The app copies it to the Ventoy drive. Copying uses no tokens.
tl.ventoy.49: Ventoy boots the ISO, WIM, IMG, VHD and EFI files on the drive. To add more, just copy them; you do not reformat or reburn the drive.
tl.ventoy.50: If the drive does not have enough free space for the file, the app shows Not Enough Space.
tl.ventoy.51: If a file with the same name is already on the drive, the app asks File already exists. Replace it?
tl.ventoy.52: If you cancel a copy, the app asks Are you sure you want to cancel the process?
tl.ventoy.53: FAT32 limits single files to 4 GB, and an ISO is copied as one file. For larger ISOs, use exFAT or NTFS.
tl.ventoy.54: Copying the ISO files from a PC works too.
tl.ventoy.55: To delete or rename files on the drive, tap USB File Manager. An ISO you delete leaves the boot menu. Copy File To USB, the download button and USB File Manager work only when Ventoy is on the drive.
tl.ventoy.56: Can I download ISO files straight to the drive?
tl.ventoy.57: Yes. Tap Download File Directly To USB FROM INTERNET. The app opens its own browser, and the file you download is written to the Ventoy drive, with the same free-space check and replace question as a copy. Downloading uses no tokens.
tl.ventoy.58: How do I choose which ISO boots at startup?
tl.ventoy.59: Start the PC from the USB drive, then pick the system you want from the Ventoy menu.
tl.ventoy.60: Open the PC's boot menu at power-on (usually F12, F11, F9 or Esc) and select the USB drive.
tl.ventoy.61: Config Hub can set a Menu timeout and a Default boot entry.
tl.ventoy.62: If the phone does not recognise the drive after setup, it is probably working: test it on a PC.
tl.ventoy.63: How do I keep my changes in a live Linux (persistence)?
tl.ventoy.64: Use Add persistence on the Persistence tab of Config Hub. The app creates an ext4 image file on the drive and links it to the ISO you choose. This uses no tokens.
tl.ventoy.65: Open Config Hub, then the Persistence tab, and tap Add persistence.
tl.ventoy.66: Step 1 of 3 · Choose the ISO: pick the Linux ISO.
tl.ventoy.67: Step 2 of 3 · Label and size: check the label and choose the size.
tl.ventoy.68: Step 3 of 3 · Confirm: tap Create. The app shows Reserving space on the drive… and then Formatting the image…
tl.ventoy.73: casper-rw (Ubuntu, Linux Mint, elementary, Zorin, Pop!_OS), MX-Persist (MX Linux), persistence (Debian, Kali, CloneZilla), vtoycow (Arch Linux, Manjaro, EndeavourOS, Fedora)
tl.ventoy.74: Detected from the ISO file name
tl.ventoy.76: 512 MB, 1 GB, 2 GB, 4 GB, 8 GB, 16 GB, or Custom size… from 256 MB to 128 GB in 256 MB steps. On a FAT32 drive the sizes stay under 4 GB.
tl.ventoy.78: The image file is named persist_ followed by the label and the size. Persistence works with the Ubuntu, Debian, MX and Arch families; openSUSE and most other systems do not support it through Ventoy.
tl.ventoy.79: What can I change with Config Hub and Theme Manager?
tl.ventoy.80: Config Hub changes Ventoy's settings on the drive (its ventoy.json file) without a computer. It has the tabs Boot, Names, Tips, Security and Persistence. After you save, the app shows Saved. Takes effect on next boot.
tl.ventoy.81: On the Boot tab you set, for example, Menu timeout (0 to 3600 seconds), Default menu mode (List or TreeView), Menu language, Keyboard layout, the file types to hide from the menu, Windows 11: bypass hardware checks and Windows 11: bypass online account. Settings in ventoy.json that the app does not show are kept.
tl.ventoy.82: Theme Manager changes how the Ventoy boot menu looks, with GRUB2 themes. Download a GRUB2 theme archive (zip, tar.gz or tar.xz), come back to Theme Manager, tap Import Theme and select the file. If the archive holds several themes, the app asks you to choose one. Use default goes back to the default theme.
tl.ventoy.83: Config Hub and Theme Manager work only when Ventoy is on the drive, and they use no tokens.
tl.ventoy.84: How many tokens does Ventoy use?
tl.ventoy.90: Copying and downloading files, USB File Manager, Config Hub, Theme Manager, persistence
tl.ventoy.91: The app shows the cost before it starts, and you earn a token by watching one short rewarded video. With Pro, Ventoy uses no tokens. If you do not have enough tokens, the app shows Not Enough Tokens with a Get Tokens button, and nothing starts.
tl.ventoy.92: The tokens come back automatically when an install, update or clear fails, when an install or clear ends before anything is written, when the chosen Ventoy version cannot be used, and when the app is closed during the job (they are returned the next time the app starts).
tl.ventoy.93: What happens if the install is interrupted?
tl.ventoy.94: Install, Update and Clear have no Cancel button, so let them finish. Keep the app in front: when it goes to the background, the job pauses, and it continues when you come back to the app. The app keeps the screen on while it is shown.
tl.ventoy.95: In the free version, a running job also pauses while the phone has no internet connection or an ad blocker or blocking Private DNS is active, and continues when that is fixed. With Pro, only the background pause applies.
tl.ventoy.96: If the drive is removed or stops answering, the job ends and the app shows The drive was removed or stopped answering. Reconnect it and try again. The tokens come back. Reconnect the drive and run the job again.
tl.ventoy.97: The app does not show a notice when a new Ventoy version comes out. Open Other version… to see the releases.
tl.ventoy.98: In USB File Manager you can pick several files at once. If a file cannot be read during an import, the app skips it and copies the rest.
tl.ventoy.99: Config Hub can also rename boot-menu entries, set a boot password and passwords for each file type, and set the tips text, its position and its color. It can repair a damaged ventoy.json file, with a backup.
tl.ventoy.100: In Theme Manager you can also apply, rename or delete a theme, and set the menu resolution.
tl.ventoy.101: Is installing Ventoy safe for my drive?
tl.ventoy.102: Yes. The app tests every Ventoy install before it reports success, and it protects the drive at each step:
tl.ventoy.103: When you connect a drive, the app checks it. If reading or writing at the end of the drive fails, it may be fake or faulty, and the app asks whether to Scan for real size or Continue anyway.
tl.ventoy.104: If the drive did not keep its test data, it may be fake. The app says so, keeps its files read-only and offers Try restore again. Install still runs after an extra Yes; if you answer No, the tokens come back.
tl.ventoy.105: A drive that is write-protected or does not take writes is recognised as soon as you start a job: one clear message, and nothing is charged.
tl.ventoy.106: Install checks and tests the new file system before the app reports success.
tl.ventoy.107: A job never writes to a different drive than the one it started on.
tl.ventoy.108: More than five years of building USB apps, and over 1,000,000 downloads each on Google Play for Ultimate USB and Ventoy (Unofficial).
tl.ventoy.109: Read more: How our USB apps keep your drive and your data safe.
tl.ventoy.110: Each failure has its own message, so you know what went wrong.
tl.ventoy.111: USB File Manager can also open a file from the drive in another app without copying it first.
tl.ventoy.112: If the USB connection fails for a moment during a job, the app recovers it automatically and the job continues.
tl.ventoy.desc: Open Ventoy, choose the partition table, file system and options, and tap Install. Then copy ISO files to the drive with Copy File To USB and pick one from the Ventoy menu when the PC starts. No PC is needed to set up the drive. Install uses 2 tokens, Update and Clear 1 each.

tl.wipe-usb.1: How do I wipe a USB drive step by step?
tl.wipe-usb.2: Connect the drive to your phone with a USB OTG adapter and open Ultimate USB or USB Tools.
tl.wipe-usb.3: Open the Disk Management group and tap Wipe USB. All data and all partitions on the drive will be deleted.
tl.wipe-usb.4: Method: choose how the drive is overwritten (see the table below).
tl.wipe-usb.6: Check the Estimated time. The app says what it is based on: this drive's speed measured in this session, a short read test of this drive, or a cautious default speed.
tl.wipe-usb.7: Tap START. If the wipe will take more than one hour, the app shows Long erasure: the app has to stay open in the foreground all that time. Tap Start to go on.
tl.wipe-usb.8: The app shows the drive's vendor, product and serial number and says that everything on the drive will be overwritten and that this cannot be undone. Check that it is the right drive, then confirm.
tl.wipe-usb.9: While it runs, the app shows Wiping · pass x of y and Do not disconnect the drive. With verification, it then shows Verifying and checks the drive.
tl.wipe-usb.10: At the end the result card shows Erasure complete, Erasure incomplete or Erasure failed. Tap View erasure certificate or View erasure report and save it.
tl.wipe-usb.11: Which wipe methods can I choose?
tl.wipe-usb.12: Five methods. The default is NIST SP 800-88 Clear (1 pass), and the app remembers your choice for the next wipe.
tl.wipe-usb.20: Random data, then random data again
tl.wipe-usb.26: 0xFF, then 0x00, then random data five times
tl.wipe-usb.29: 4 random passes, 27 fixed patterns in random order, then 4 random passes
tl.wipe-usb.31: How does the app verify the wipe?
tl.wipe-usb.32: It checks the drive after writing. The default is Sampled (recommended). Australian ISM and DoD 5220.22-M always use Full, whatever you select.
tl.wipe-usb.36: No check. The report states that no check was performed.
tl.wipe-usb.38: Checks samples from across the whole drive. Adds about ten seconds. On a very small drive, the whole drive is checked.
tl.wipe-usb.40: Checks the whole drive. The app shows how much time this adds for your drive.
tl.wipe-usb.41: The wipe covers the writable size of the drive. On a drive that reports more space than it really stores, only the writable part is overwritten, and the report says so.
tl.wipe-usb.42: What is in the erasure report and certificate?
tl.wipe-usb.43: The Data erasure report describes the wipe in detail. The Certificate of erasure is issued only for a completed erasure. Both are made on your phone, offline, and go nowhere unless you share them. They contain:
tl.wipe-usb.44: Header: Report ID, issue date and the time it was generated. Each page footer shows the page number and the report ID.
tl.wipe-usb.45: Device: the drive's maker, model and serial number, its Reported capacity and its Writable capacity. A drive that stores less than it claims shows a smaller writable capacity.
tl.wipe-usb.46: Sanitization method: the erasure method and standard, and each pass.
tl.wipe-usb.47: Result: whether it completed, stopped or failed; start and finish time, duration, data written, errors, and every pause and continue.
tl.wipe-usb.48: Verification: whether the check passed, failed or was not done.
tl.wipe-usb.49: Scope and limitations: what a wipe over USB can and cannot reach (see below).
tl.wipe-usb.50: Your details (optional): name, title, organization, location, contact, asset number, media source, an attestation, and a place to sign and date. Tap Apply to add them. They are kept on your phone only and remembered for the next wipe.
tl.wipe-usb.52: How do I save the report?
tl.wipe-usb.53: Tap Save to store it as a PDF in a place you pick, Share to send it, or Export as plain text. Turn on Open this automatically after a wipe to see it every time a wipe ends.
tl.wipe-usb.54: Save the report before you leave. It cannot be produced again later. If you leave without saving, the app shows Report not saved with Save now and Discard.
tl.wipe-usb.55: What can a wipe over USB not reach?
tl.wipe-usb.56: The report states these limits openly:
tl.wipe-usb.57: The wipe is at the NIST "Clear" level, not "Purge" or "Destroy".
tl.wipe-usb.58: Hidden spare areas inside a flash drive cannot be reached from a phone.
tl.wipe-usb.60: Device identifiers are shown as the device reports them.
tl.wipe-usb.61: How many tokens does a wipe use?
tl.wipe-usb.62: None. Wipe USB is free with every method.
tl.wipe-usb.63: Can I pause a wipe or continue it later?
tl.wipe-usb.64: Yes. Tap Pause. The app saves its position, and nothing is written to the drive until you tap Continue. It then goes on from the same pass and the same place.
tl.wipe-usb.65: If you leave the app, the wipe is paused the same way and continues when the app is in front again. Without Pro, it is also paused while the phone is offline or an ad blocker is active.
tl.wipe-usb.66: If the wipe is stopped, the drive is removed or the app is closed, the wipe stays saved. When you connect the same drive again, the app shows Continue wipe with Continue and Discard.
tl.wipe-usb.67: If you discard a saved wipe, the drive stays partly erased, and a new wipe starts from the beginning.
tl.wipe-usb.68: A drive that is write-protected or does not take writes is refused before the app asks you anything.
tl.wipe-usb.69: If the connection to the drive fails for a moment, the app recovers it and goes on. The report lists these as bus recoveries.
tl.wipe-usb.70: Is wiping safe for my drive?
tl.wipe-usb.71: Yes. The app can read the drive back to check the wipe, and it erases only the drive you confirmed:
tl.wipe-usb.72: If the drive did not keep its test data, it may be fake. The app says so, keeps its files read-only and offers Try restore again. A wipe still runs after an extra Yes.
tl.wipe-usb.73: A job never writes to a different drive than the one it started on.
tl.wipe-usb.74: More than five years of building USB apps, and over 1,000,000 downloads each on Google Play for Ultimate USB and USB Tools.
tl.wipe-usb.75: Read more: How our USB apps keep your drive and your data safe.
tl.wipe-usb.76: If the drive's real size was not scanned, the certificate and the result do not claim that its whole stated size was erased: the real capacity shows as —, with a note that only the part the drive really stores was covered.
tl.wipe-usb.desc: Open Wipe USB in Ultimate USB or USB Tools, choose one of five methods and the verification, and tap START. The app overwrites the whole drive, can check it afterwards, and issues an erasure report and certificate. Wiping uses no tokens.
